rows.title: Customer Success Manager (CSM) - SAP Next Gen - SAP Academy for Customer Success - D.C (Hybrid)
rows.descriptionText:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a development program designed for individuals with 1-3 years of professional experience.

Candidate(s) will be required to work 3 days a week in office/client site as per our Pledge to Flex return to office policy.

SAP is not offering relocation benefits for this role at this time.

SAP is not offering current or future visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Who You’ll Become

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) works directly with customers to guide them through their business journey with our solutions. The CSM works to increase customer satisfaction, retention, renewals, references, and upsells for Cloud products within their assigned solution portfolio. The CSM oversees key customer milestones throughout the customer lifecycle, from deal signature through system provisioning, monitoring implementation progress, and business case achievement. The CSM is expected to serve as the strategic point of contact for the customer within the assigned solution portfolio and to leverage appropriate resources across SAP functions to maintain overall customer health.

What You’ll Do

As a CSM within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to: 

Successfully complete a 10-month learn-apply program, which includes classroom phases and field phases with your CSM team, that enhances your support in the CSM role, a critical customer-facing function within our dynamic Customer Success board area.   Immerse yourself in multi-dimensional, experiential learning with a focus on digital transformation, global intelligence, human skills, business and technology acumen, solution/industry knowledge, and strategy/tools/process.  Enhance skills around your solution portfolio, managing customer retention, and driving value realization. Receive onboarding in your local market with on-the-job training and mentoring by a senior CSM professional in the field. You will have the opportunity to work both behind the scenes and directly with customers. 

The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and the Customer Success board area and give you the professional experience to be ready to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning application for your role. Upon successful completion of the program, you will move into a direct customer-facing CSM role in your market and continue to receive mentoring and coaching support to accelerate your growth.

What You Bring

2–3 years of experience supporting customers and driving business transformation, ideally in consulting or account management. Proven ability to deliver strategic guidance and solutions that drive customer success and long-term value, coupled with experience in resolving issues and managing escalations to ensure satisfaction and business continuity. A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally. A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results. An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI. Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries. Proficiency in English to engage with our global network. AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering) A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively. Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement. A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative. 

CSM Focus Areas

SAP Finance & Spend Management (F&S) – Knowledge in key areas such as accounting, procurement, and supplier management, focused on boosting visibility, cutting costs, and improving efficiency.

S/4HANA Finance Finance & Quote to Cash(Q2C) Procurement 

SAP SuccessFactors (Human Capital Management - HCM) - Knowledge in core HR and payroll, talent management, employee experience management, HR analytics, workforce planning, and sales performance management.

SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) - Knowledge in Supply Chain, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Logistics, or Product and Project lifecycle management.

SAP Customer Experience (CX) - Knowledge of e-commerce, sales, customer service, and marketing processes.

SAP Business Transformation Management (BTM) - Knowledge in Business Process Management/Business Process Automation applications.

SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) & SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) - Knowledge in database and data management, analytics, application development and integration, intelligent technologies, and AI. Understanding of Integration, Application, Data, Infrastructure, and Security technology domains.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.

About SAP Academy For Customer Success 

The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.

Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands-on experience with world-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.

#SAPAcademyforCustomerSuccess

#SAPNextGen

SAP Next Gen is our global experience for students and early talent (0–3 years of professional work experience). Being a part of the Next Gen community provides access to a supportive global network, tailored development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to high-impact projects across the business.

SAP’s employees across different regions are enabled to do their best job with the right mix of office and remote work according to country-specific guidelines and regulations. In general, our hybrid work setup consists of three days a week in the office or on-site with customers or partners.

We are planning a practical and immersive portion of our program, which will likely involve participants spending four (4) weeks, spread across two trips, in San Ramon, California. This experience is designed to provide unparalleled hands-on learning and networking opportunities. During intensive phases of the program, it is critical that all participants are fully engaged and present to ensure maximum learning and success. As such, vacation will not be approved during some critical times of the program. 

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

SAP provides the annualized compensation range inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target for the career level applicable to the posted role. The targeted annual combined range for this position is 78,000 - 180,700. The actual amount to be offered to the successful candidate will be within that range, dependent upon the key aspects of each case which may include education, skills, experience, scope of the role, location, etc. as determined through the selection process. rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The Authorizations platform is responsible for millions of spend decisions for COF credit and debit cards each day. One of the greatest areas of opportunity to unlock additional value from this platform is to improve the speed, ease, and reliability by which data be implemented for use in authorizations decisions. This stack will blend the latest Capital One enterprise data tools, the team’s custom components tailored to Authorizations requirements, and new data sources that are evolving from around the company.

Organization

U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)

Reference Code

How To Apply

Connect with ORISE...on the GO! Download the new ORISE GO mobile app in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store to help you stay engaged, connected, and informed during your ORISE experience and beyond!

A Complete Application Consists Of:

An applicationTranscripts – Click here for detailed information about acceptable transcriptsA current resume/CV, including academic history, employment history, relevant experiences, and publication listOne educational or professional recommendation

All documents must be in English or include an official English translation.

If you have questions, send an email to ORISE.FDA.CDRH@orau.org. Please include the reference code for this opportunity in your email.

Application Deadline

9/30/2027 3:00:00 PM Eastern Time Zone

Description

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling-basis.

FDA Office and Location: Ther are up to 14 fellowship opportunities currently available with the Center for Devices and Radiological Health, Division of Imaging, Diagnostics, and Software Reliability, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), located in Silver Spring, Maryland.

Research Project: Selected participants will join research projects focused on the development of methods and tools in support of our regulatory science efforts in evaluating computational pathology (CPATH) devices. As a fellow, you will have the opportunity to learn about the assessment of artificial intelligence models applied to whole slide images, with a focus on CPATH imaging AI pipeline and cutting-edge technologies such as vision and language foundation models in segmentation/classification/quantification/chatbot tasks.

Learning Objectives: Under the guidance of an FDA mentor, you will:

Develop comprehensive expertise in evaluating artificial intelligence algorithms applied to whole slide images, including understanding performance metrics and validation frameworkGain Proficiency in imaging AI pipeline development and optimizationAcquire hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and optimizing computational pathology workflows from image acquisition through analysis output with understanding pre-processing techniquesLearn about cutting-edge vision and language foundation models for pathology applications, including their implementation in segmentation, classification, quantification, and conversational AI tasks

Mentor: The mentor(s) for this opportunity are Aldo Badano (aldo.badano@fda.hhs.gov) and Weijie Chen (weijie.chen@fda.hhs.gov) . If you have questions about the nature of the research, please contact the mentor(s).

Anticipated Appointment Start Date: Spring 2026. Start date is flexible and will depend on a variety of factors.

Appointment Length: The appointment will initially be for one year, but may be renewed upon recommendation of FDA and is contingent on the availability of funds.

Level of Participation: The appointment is full time.

Participant Stipend: The participant will receive a monthly stipend commensurate with educational level and experience.

Participants do not become employees of FDA, DOE or the program administrator, and there are no employment-related benefits.

OPM can complete a background investigation only for individuals, including non-US Citizens, who have resided in the US for a total of three of the past five years.

If an ORISE Fellow, to include their spouse and minor children, reports what is identified as a Significantly Regulated Organization (SRO) or prohibited investment fund financial interest in any amount, or a relationship with an SRO, except for spousal employment with an SRO, and the individual will not voluntarily divest the financial interest or terminate the relationship, then the individual is not placed at FDA. For additional requirements, see FDA Ethics for Nonemployee Scientists.

rows.title: Quantitative Survey Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Your Job

As a Quantitative Survey Analyst, you will own the analytic integrity of assigned studies from instrument design through final deliverables. You will translate research questions into effective survey designs and complex survey data into clear, actionable findings that unlock value for customers. Your work will ensure conclusions are statistically defensible, insightful to clients, and supported by documented, reproducible analysis.

Our Team

Our survey research team partners with customers across various disciplines to design studies, analyze public opinion, and turn rigorous research into insights that drive competitive advantage for customers. This role will provide support to various Koch companies including Rushmore Labs and i360.

This role is not eligible for Visa sponsorship.

What You Will Do

Lead the analytical work for assigned survey studies, from questionnaire consultation and instrument review through final findings and deliverables. Analyze weighted survey data using toplines and crosstabs to identify meaningful patterns, subgroup differences, and the storylines most relevant to clients. Evaluate subgroup differences and changes across studies, distinguishing defensible findings from sampling noise or methodological artifacts. Build and interpret linear and logistic regression models to identify drivers of attitudes and behaviors. Conduct segmentation and dimension-reduction analyses, including principal component analysis, factor analysis, latent class analysis, and k-means or hierarchical clustering. Translate complex results into clear written summaries, charts, presentations, and usable segment profiles for technical and non-technical audiences. Write documented, reproducible code and respond to ad hoc analysis needs across active and completed studies. 


Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Experience analyzing survey research data, including weighted data, toplines, and crosstabs. Experience applying statistical testing to evaluate subgroup differences or changes across studies. Experience building and interpreting linear or logistic regression models. Experience conducting segmentation, clustering, factor analysis, principal component analysis, latent class analysis, or comparable multivariate methods. Experience using R or Python to produce documented, reproducible analyses and client-ready deliverables. 


What Will Put You Ahead

Bachelor’s or advanced degree in statistics, survey methodology, political science, data science, economics, or a related quantitative field. Experience consulting on questionnaire wording, message testing, bias, and analyzability before fielding. Experience comparing results across recurring, tracking, or methodologically similar surveys. Experience translating advanced statistical findings into recommendations for client or executive audiences. Experience using R, Python, SQL, Qualtrics, Alchemer, or other survey research and analysis tools. 


For this role, we anticipate paying $120,000-$170,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

Koch creates and innovates a wide spectrum of products and services that make life better. Our work spans a vast number of industries across the world, including engineered technology, refining, chemicals and polymers, pulp and paper, glass, electronics and many more. Headquartered in Wichita, Kansas, Koch employs about 120,000 employees across the globe.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E-Verify. Please click here for additional information. (For Illinois E-Verify information click here, aquí, or tu).

rows.title: Customer Success Manager (CSM) - SAP Next Gen - SAP Academy for Customer Success - D.C (Hybrid)
rows.descriptionText:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a development program designed for individuals with 1-3 years of professional experience.

Candidate(s) will be required to work 3 days a week in office/client site as per our Pledge to Flex return to office policy.

SAP is not offering relocation benefits for this role at this time.

SAP is not offering current or future visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Who You’ll Become

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) works directly with customers to guide them through their business journey with our solutions. The CSM works to increase customer satisfaction, retention, renewals, references, and upsells for Cloud products within their assigned solution portfolio. The CSM oversees key customer milestones throughout the customer lifecycle, from deal signature through system provisioning, monitoring implementation progress, and business case achievement. The CSM is expected to serve as the strategic point of contact for the customer within the assigned solution portfolio and to leverage appropriate resources across SAP functions to maintain overall customer health.

What You’ll Do

As a CSM within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to: 

Successfully complete a 10-month learn-apply program, which includes classroom phases and field phases with your CSM team, that enhances your support in the CSM role, a critical customer-facing function within our dynamic Customer Success board area.   Immerse yourself in multi-dimensional, experiential learning with a focus on digital transformation, global intelligence, human skills, business and technology acumen, solution/industry knowledge, and strategy/tools/process.  Enhance skills around your solution portfolio, managing customer retention, and driving value realization. Receive onboarding in your local market with on-the-job training and mentoring by a senior CSM professional in the field. You will have the opportunity to work both behind the scenes and directly with customers. 

The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and the Customer Success board area and give you the professional experience to be ready to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning application for your role. Upon successful completion of the program, you will move into a direct customer-facing CSM role in your market and continue to receive mentoring and coaching support to accelerate your growth.

What You Bring

2–3 years of experience supporting customers and driving business transformation, ideally in consulting or account management. Proven ability to deliver strategic guidance and solutions that drive customer success and long-term value, coupled with experience in resolving issues and managing escalations to ensure satisfaction and business continuity. A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally. A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results. An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI. Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries. Proficiency in English to engage with our global network. AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering) A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively. Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement. A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative. 

CSM Focus Areas

SAP Finance & Spend Management (F&S) – Knowledge in key areas such as accounting, procurement, and supplier management, focused on boosting visibility, cutting costs, and improving efficiency.

S/4HANA Finance Finance & Quote to Cash(Q2C) Procurement 

SAP SuccessFactors (Human Capital Management - HCM) - Knowledge in core HR and payroll, talent management, employee experience management, HR analytics, workforce planning, and sales performance management.

SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) - Knowledge in Supply Chain, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Logistics, or Product and Project lifecycle management.

SAP Customer Experience (CX) - Knowledge of e-commerce, sales, customer service, and marketing processes.

SAP Business Transformation Management (BTM) - Knowledge in Business Process Management/Business Process Automation applications.

SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) & SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) - Knowledge in database and data management, analytics, application development and integration, intelligent technologies, and AI. Understanding of Integration, Application, Data, Infrastructure, and Security technology domains.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.

About SAP Academy For Customer Success 

The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.

Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands-on experience with world-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.

#SAPAcademyforCustomerSuccess

#SAPNextGen

SAP Next Gen is our global experience for students and early talent (0–3 years of professional work experience). Being a part of the Next Gen community provides access to a supportive global network, tailored development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to high-impact projects across the business.

SAP’s employees across different regions are enabled to do their best job with the right mix of office and remote work according to country-specific guidelines and regulations. In general, our hybrid work setup consists of three days a week in the office or on-site with customers or partners.

We are planning a practical and immersive portion of our program, which will likely involve participants spending four (4) weeks, spread across two trips, in San Ramon, California. This experience is designed to provide unparalleled hands-on learning and networking opportunities. During intensive phases of the program, it is critical that all participants are fully engaged and present to ensure maximum learning and success. As such, vacation will not be approved during some critical times of the program. 

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

Compensation Range Transparency: SAP believes the value of pay transparency contributes towards an honest and supportive culture and is a significant step toward demonstrating SAP’s commitment to pay equity. SAP provides the annualized compensation range inclusive of base salary and variable incentive target for the career level applicable to the posted role. The targeted annual combined range for this position is 78,000 - 180,700. The actual amount to be offered to the successful candidate will be within that range, dependent upon the key aspects of each case which may include education, skills, experience, scope of the role, location, etc. as determined through the selection process. Any SAP variable incentive includes a targeted dollar amount and any actual payout amount is dependent on company and personal performance. For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron’s for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients’ best interests — always.*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

This role is responsible for overseeing the execution of the firm’s service model, ensuring that client experiences align with the firm’s standards and values. The Relationship Manager I plays a critical role in practice management, client retention, and business growth, serving as a key contributor to the success of the advisory team.

This role offers a clear career path to Relationship Manager II and III, with increasing levels of strategic influence, leadership, and client engagement.

No heavy lifting over 10 lbs.

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI has a need for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team. This is an exciting full time opportunity to work in a fast paced, environment serving a critical government mission.

This position is located in our Lafayette, Louisiana or Knoxville Tennessee or Fairfax, VA office; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable.

Your future duties and responsibilities

 Review, analyze, and evaluate business processes, systems, and user needs based on the program scope. Translate business requirements into technical specifications to ensure that business objectives are achieved. Determine client requirements and transform them into system specifications, translating requirements into technical language for developers, and identifying opportunities for improving business processes. Facilitate requirements workshops to gather business and functional requirements, create and review test plans and scenarios, and prepare and conduct reviews and training sessions. Document process flows, analyze and re engineer processes, understanding technical problems and solutions in relation to the current and future business environment. Recommend and facilitate quality improvement efforts. Integrate new processes with existing ones and communicate these changes to impacted Business Systems teams. Provide technical guidance to a cross functional, Scaled Agile (SAFe) team. Act as a trusted advisor to clients on complex technical issues or business strategy.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 Bachelor's degree in business, Information Technology, Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related discipline Minimum of 5 years' experience as a Business Analyst. Ability to conduct data and systems analysis on data pipeline applications and processes. Experience working on an Agile development team Experience supporting development of complex systems, with strong troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in data analysis and data visualization to draw business relevant conclusions. Expertise in planning and conducting facilitative sessions for requirements gathering. Ability to work effectively in a team environment. Experience creating detailed reports and delivering presentations. Excellent communication skills in a client facing role. Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) products such as Microsoft Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, Service Desk, etc. Strong facilitation and communication skills to gather requirements and collaborate with stakeholders Proficiency in Microsoft Suite of tools, data modeling, SQL/Database querying Ability to translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications. Experience writing user stories with technical acceptance criteria. Knowledge of interface control documents (ICDs) and system specification documents (SSDs). Understanding of Agile SAFe frameworks commonly used in federal projects. Ability to work with development teams to refine technical requirements and support testing. Experience with functional, integration, and regression testing techniques.

Desired qualifications/non essential skills required:

Industry knowledge in sectors such as Government and Aviation preferred CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role.

 Experience with enterprise systems integration (API driven, SOA, microservices). Understanding of system architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, and UML. Familiarity with FAA legacy systems and modernization environments (e.g., NAS systems, ATO platforms). SQL proficiency for querying and validating data. Understanding of relational database concepts. Experience with data modeling (logical and physical). Familiarity with data governance, data lineage, and metadata management. Exposure to analytics platforms (Power BI). Experience with Agile tools (Jira, Azure DevOps). Exposure to API documentation tools. Understanding of version control (Git).

CGI is required by law in some jurisdictions to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. rows.title: Analyst (DC - August 2027 Start)
rows.descriptionText:
Ready to make a meaningful impact?

At Brighton Jones, we’re a purpose-driven, client-focused team committed to helping individuals live richer lives. As one of the largest RIAs in the nation, we’ve built a culture of continuous growth, collaboration, and community—recognized with 15 consecutive “Best Places to Work” awards including Inc.com’s 2025 list, as well as national honors for community impact.

We lead the industry in aligning wealth, passion, and purpose to help our clients thrive. With over $30 billion in assets under advisement, 300+ teammates nationwide, and a dynamic, team-based approach, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for driven, curious individuals to join our #OneTeam.

We are looking for our next Analyst. Analysts build the foundational knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to support clients and advisory teams at a high level. Working alongside experienced advisors, Analysts gain exposure to financial planning, client service, and business operations while participating in structured training, coaching, and hands-on development opportunities. Through meaningful client work and continuous learning, Analysts develop the capabilities needed to take on increasing responsibility and grow within the advisory profession.

Take our Values in Action Self-Assessment to see how our values align!

What You’ll Do:

Financial Planning & Analysis:

Prepare financial planning, investment, and wealth management analyses and deliverables in partnership with advisory team members.Support portfolio reviews and investment research by gathering data, conducting analyses, and helping identify opportunities for discussion with the advisory team.Conduct analyses related to financial planning topics, including tax planning, equity compensation, retirement planning, and wealth transfer strategies while maintaining accurate client and portfolio records.Partner with Tax, Investments, Estate Planning, and advisory teams to support the development and implementation of client recommendations.Build technical expertise, professional judgment, and client service skills through structured training, coaching, and real-world client work.


Client Meeting Preparation & Delivery:

Partner with advisory teams to prepare client meeting agendas, analyze client data, support the development of recommendations, prepare client deliverables, and document client action items in Salesforce.Support tax coordination and implementation activities for clients' personal and trust accounts, working closely with advisory team members and internal specialists.Coordinate and track client service team priorities, ensuring follow-through on action items and helping deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience.


Operations & Client Service: 

Support the day-to-day priorities of advisory teams by providing analytical, operational, and client service support throughout the client lifecycle.Partner with advisory team members to execute time-sensitive client requests, including trades, wire transfers, and journals, while ensuring accuracy, proper approvals, timely completion, and clear communication.Work closely with custodians and internal partners to support account servicing, operational requests, and client-related inquiries.Gather, organize, and maintain client information within Salesforce and other firm systems, ensuring accurate records and high-quality client data.


Your Experience:

Bachelor’s degree required (preferably in Financial Planning, Finance, Accounting, Business, or Economics)Academic success and other internships or work-related experience preferred.Series 65 (or equivalent) or ability to obtain within 120 days of hire.Strong interest in pursuing the Certified Financial Planner (CFP) credential in the future.Baseline proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite products (Word, Excel, Windows) required; expected to learn other position-related systems on the job.


Skills & Attributes:

Demonstrates professionalism, integrity, accountability, and sound judgment.Communicates clearly and builds trust with clients, teammates, and business partners.Takes ownership, follows through on commitments, and proactively seeks solutions.Applies analytical thinking, curiosity, and attention to detail to complex financial information.Organizes work effectively and manages multiple priorities with accuracy and reliability.Welcomes feedback and demonstrates a commitment to continuous learning and development.Contributes positively to team culture and is motivated to deliver exceptional client experience.


Program Details:

Position to begin on August 9, 2027.This role is an in-office, and exempt position. We are a work from office culture with lots of flexibility.


Analyst Training Program (ATP)

As an Analyst, you will participate in the Analyst Training Program (ATP), a structured development experience designed to build the foundational knowledge, skills, and experiences needed to support clients and grow your career at Brighton Jones. The program combines formal training, hands-on learning, coaching, mentorship, and practical application to help Analysts develop the capabilities required for long-term success.

During the program, you will: 

Complete required onboarding, training, and licensing milestones, including preparation for and completion of the Series 65 examination.Participate in classroom-based and real-world learning designed to build foundational financial planning, client service, and business knowledge.Apply learning through guided practice, job shadowing, and progressively challenging client-related work assignments.Partner closely with a dedicated Training Partner and People Manager who will provide coaching, feedback, and support throughout the program.Build relationships across the firm through collaboration with teammates, mentors, and cross-functional partners.Develop an understanding of the Brighton Jones client experience, business model, and career development framework.Progress toward demonstrated proficiency in key Analyst competencies and ATP graduation requirements.Program Length: The program is designed to be completed within 6 - 12 months. Timing may vary based on licensing completion, demonstrated proficiency against defined Analyst competencies, quality and consistency of work, and readiness for increasingly independent assignments.Completion & Graduation: Successful completion confirms that the Analyst has demonstrated the program’s foundational competencies. Future career progression will be evaluated separately based on sustained performance, demonstrated readiness, credential requirements, business needs, and the firm’s promotion process.


Compensation:

Pay: $81,000 per year


Ownership & Financial Wellbeing

Fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees401(k) with 100% match up to 3% of annual compensationEquity ownership opportunities for every employeeNew Business Incentive ProgramGenerous employee referral bonusCell phone data reimbursementFinancial planning services discount for employees and immediate family members

100% reimbursement for required training, certifications, licensing, and duesPersonal career development plansRicher Life Business Partner (coaching for all employees)Mindful Emotional & Social Intelligence trainingAnnual professional & personal wellbeing stipend


Connection & Community

Quarterly team-building eventsRegular social eventsEmployee-led book clubs, committees, and affinity groups


Family & Milestones

Paid Parental leave (13 weeks for birthing parent and 6 weeks for non-birthing parent)Adoption benefitsAnniversary milestone celebrations, including a 3-month paid sabbatical at 10 years


Visa Sponsorship: Please note, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for the position offered. Accordingly, we are unable to hire individuals who require, or will require, employment visa sponsorship either now or in the future. 

We are committed to building a business where all of our team members genuinely love where they work and are empowered to reach their full potential. We do this by building authentic relationships with one another, learning and growing continuously together, working hard while having lots of fun, and giving back to our community.

Brighton Jones is a team founded on equity and respect, and we’re on a mission to help each other, our clients, and global community thrive. We actively foster a compassionate and inclusive culture and are committed to creating a diverse #OneTeam where teammates can show up authentically.

To the right individual, we offer very competitive compensation, a robust benefits package, an award-winning culture, and rewarding career growth.

rows.descriptionText:
Product Management 

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

About the Team:

The Authorizations platform is responsible for millions of spend decisions for COF credit and debit cards each day. Our mission is to “unleash customer spend while making the best decision on each and every auth.” In less than one second, our platform harnesses the power of big data, sophisticated rulesets, and machine learning to achieve this goal. In doing so, we empower internal customers across fraud and credit teams to implement dynamic authorization policies that reduce fraud loss, enable higher spend, and enhance customer experience - all while appropriately managing risk.

One of the greatest areas of opportunity to unlock additional value from this platform is to improve the speed, ease, and reliability by which data be implemented for use in authorizations decisions. To help reach that goal, we are seeking a tech-driven, data-minded product manager to play a critical role in driving the adoption of a new foundational E2E tech stack. This stack will blend the latest Capital One enterprise data tools, the team’s custom components tailored to Authorizations requirements, and new data sources that are evolving from around the company.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human Centered You’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business Focused Demonstrating a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

Technology Driven You’ll work autonomously in an agile environment, to conduct research and develop features that utilize new and evolving technology You’ll collaborate with designers, technologists, data scientists and subject-matter experts to build cutting edge solutions to help customersYou’ll deliver well-managed product platforms for customers by seeking to understand technology trends and architecture strategy

Transformational Leadership By actively participating in horizontal forums, you’ll harness a network of trusted relationships among tech teams, designers, key internal stakeholders and partner teamsYou’ll articulate a succinct product roadmap to deliver business value and share with with stakeholders, elevating your team’s results and becoming a product matter expert

Bachelor’s degree or military experienceAt least 1 year of product management experience or at least 1 year of experience in product design, agile delivery, business analysis, data science, or software engineering

rows.title: Utilities Allocations Program Specialist I (Program Specialist I)

company.name: Anne Arundel County Office of Personnel

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

Position Description

This announcement will be used to fill a full-time, permanent Program Specialist I position in the Bureau of Utility Operations in the Department of Public Works with Anne Arundel County Government.This position provides program assistance for the management of the Allocations program for the Bureau, as well as assists with program management for other areas . The main tasks include conducting permit research, reviewing documentation, and evaluating utility and allocation project records to ensure regulatory compliance and accuracy, financial management, billing, account maintenance and reconciliation, evaluation and recordkeeping of utility and allocation projects as well as other program related responsibilities.

NATURE AND VARIETY OF WORK 

This position is responsible for providing reconciliation support for the Allocations workgroup within the Financial Services division of the Bureau . This employee is responsible for maintaining accurate records, account reconciliations, monthly billing procedures, tracking fees, payments and charges to ensure billings are accurately and timely recorded to comply with County Code and departmental procedures .

Examples Of Duties And Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

(Note: The duties and responsibilities enumerated in this class specification are for the purpose of determining a common set of minimum qualifications and salary level for all positions in this class . They are not intended to include all of the essential functions of all positions in the class . )

Researches, assesses and updates for permit allocation within the county's permitting system .

Creates, revises allocation fees and equivalent dwelling unit counts within the permitting system .

Creates, monitors, and maintains electronic and paper-based records regarding utility allocations for water and sewer service .

Reviews and calculates utility assessments and charges . Ensures the billing information is accurate and tracked . Notifies the Office of Inspections and Permits and/or Office of Finance when errors are discovered .

Conducts monthly reviews of permitting, connection, and billing activity for all allocation projects.

Oversees the preparation and approves the allocation reservation request forms used to establish billing of fees; and coordinates the establishment of fees with the Office of Finance .

Evaluates and prepares records required for annual tax sale . Calculates fees that are due, and coordinates information with the Office of Finance .

Serves as the county liaison for citizens, developers, and internal agencies regarding permitting and allocation inquiries. Reviews construction plans, permit details, billing data, and tax records for tenant improvements and developer projects to accurately calculate Equivalent Residential Units (EDUs) for Capital Facility Capacity Charges (CCFCs). C reates, generates, evaluates and provides various allocation and assessment reports to track program activity; process data used to generate invoices for payment by developers; verify data or identify inaccuracies in data; and monitor changing trends and patterns .

Utilizes various applications, software programs and reports to retrieve information used to make allocation decisions . Prepares year end adjustment schedules .

Assists Allocations Supervisor with daily managerial responsibilities as needed, and provides supervisory coverage in supervisor’s absence . Performs related duties as required .

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge of assigned department program areas, alongside a general understanding of applicable County, State, and Federal regulations and procedures. Ability to conduct targeted research, including analyzing water usage data, property details and water and sewer history, permit documents, and basic construction plans. Ability to organize, compile, and analyze research data and effectively communicate findings both orally and in writing to assist with fee assessments and necessary record corrections. Proven ability to interact tactfully, effectively, and equitably with diverse individuals, with the flexibility to participate in meetings both in person and virtually.

Minimum Qualifications

Graduation from an accredited four-year college or university; and one (1) or more years of professional-level experience in either office or program management, which must include responsibility for conducting research and data analysis to evaluate operations and inform policy, maintaining accurate and compliant record-keeping systems, and managing financial operations such as fee assessments, billing, and revenue tracking.

Supplemental Qualifications

Preference will be given to applicants who possess the following:

 Bachelor's degree with major course work in public or business administration, finance, or related field  One (1) or more years' professional-level office or program management experience record-keeping systems and billing management  Experience in conducting research on water/sewer data, properties, and permits, with proven skill in reading and interpreting basic construction plans.

rows.title: Customer Success Manager (CSM) - SAP Next Gen - SAP Academy for Customer Success - D.C (Hybrid)
rows.descriptionText:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a development program designed for individuals with 1-3 years of professional experience.

Candidate(s) will be required to work 3 days a week in office/client site as per our Pledge to Flex return to office policy.

SAP is not offering relocation benefits for this role at this time.

SAP is not offering current or future visa sponsorship for this role at this time.

Who You’ll Become

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) works directly with customers to guide them through their business journey with our solutions. The CSM works to increase customer satisfaction, retention, renewals, references, and upsells for Cloud products within their assigned solution portfolio. The CSM oversees key customer milestones throughout the customer lifecycle, from deal signature through system provisioning, monitoring implementation progress, and business case achievement. The CSM is expected to serve as the strategic point of contact for the customer within the assigned solution portfolio and to leverage appropriate resources across SAP functions to maintain overall customer health.

What You’ll Do

As a CSM within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to: 

Successfully complete a 10-month learn-apply program, which includes classroom phases and field phases with your CSM team, that enhances your support in the CSM role, a critical customer-facing function within our dynamic Customer Success board area.   Immerse yourself in multi-dimensional, experiential learning with a focus on digital transformation, global intelligence, human skills, business and technology acumen, solution/industry knowledge, and strategy/tools/process.  Enhance skills around your solution portfolio, managing customer retention, and driving value realization. Receive onboarding in your local market with on-the-job training and mentoring by a senior CSM professional in the field. You will have the opportunity to work both behind the scenes and directly with customers. 

The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and the Customer Success board area and give you the professional experience to be ready to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning application for your role. Upon successful completion of the program, you will move into a direct customer-facing CSM role in your market and continue to receive mentoring and coaching support to accelerate your growth.

What You Bring

2–3 years of experience supporting customers and driving business transformation, ideally in consulting or account management. Proven ability to deliver strategic guidance and solutions that drive customer success and long-term value, coupled with experience in resolving issues and managing escalations to ensure satisfaction and business continuity. A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally. A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results. An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI. Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries. Proficiency in English to engage with our global network. AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering) A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively. Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement. A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative. 

CSM Focus Areas

SAP Finance & Spend Management (F&S) – Knowledge in key areas such as accounting, procurement, and supplier management, focused on boosting visibility, cutting costs, and improving efficiency.

S/4HANA Finance Finance & Quote to Cash(Q2C) Procurement 

SAP SuccessFactors (Human Capital Management - HCM) - Knowledge in core HR and payroll, talent management, employee experience management, HR analytics, workforce planning, and sales performance management.

SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) - Knowledge in Supply Chain, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Logistics, or Product and Project lifecycle management.

SAP Customer Experience (CX) - Knowledge of e-commerce, sales, customer service, and marketing processes.

SAP Business Transformation Management (BTM) - Knowledge in Business Process Management/Business Process Automation applications.

SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) & SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) - Knowledge in database and data management, analytics, application development and integration, intelligent technologies, and AI. Understanding of Integration, Application, Data, Infrastructure, and Security technology domains.

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.

About SAP Academy For Customer Success

rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities.
