rows.title: Analyst Digital Marketing Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Reporting into the Digital & Social Intelligence Manager within the Commercial Excellence organization, the Digital Marketing Analyst will be a crucial addition to a team whose mission is to implement an adaptive, industry-leading Digital & Social Intelligence capability into Nestle USA that is considered a trusted source of actionable, real-time insight into consumer behavior, perception & culture. The Digital & Social Intelligence capability has been built to support stakeholders across Brand Marketing, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Consumer & Marketplace Insights, Social Strategy & Community, Foresight, Innovation, Category Strategy, Corporate Communication and other teams; ultimately, our goal is to fully embed the capability throughout Nestle USA and empower stakeholders across every department to act upon real-time digital & social insights.

While supporting the established aspects of our Digital Intelligence capability (content performance reporting, web analytics, email/CRM, etc) and the final implementation stages of our Social Intelligence capability (social listening & related social research), the Analyst will also support the emerging AI Readiness capability through LLM Listening & Visibility analysis. Across all of these capabilities, the Analyst’s role will focus on robust stakeholder relationship building with teams across the organization, working hand-in-hand with stakeholders to enable basic self-service monitoring that allows for the Analyst’s time to deliver more in-depth analysis for our brands. The insights the Analyst will deliver will originate from both cadenced and ad-hoc research requests, while the feedback the Analyst gathers will inform how we optimize & evolve the Digital & Social Intelligence capability over time using ever-evolving AI-driven technology.

The Analyst will work in collaboration with other stakeholders within the Center of Demand Generation, including but not limited to Foresight, Consumer Insights, Marketing Analytics, Digital Shelf & eCommerce, Innovation & Social Strategy to provide capabilities and services that consistently identify, generate & distribute actionable & timely insights to Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand Marketing teams within NUSA’s business divisions.

The Analyst will be expected to work with our stakeholder teams to understand Nestle USA’s business objectives and brand strategies across a wide variety of product categories such as coffee, coffee creamer, chocolate & desserts, frozen meals, pizza, snacking, baking ingredients, noodles and sauces. Day-to-day activities vary given the nature of our business, but the Analyst can expect to balance answering business questions through in-depth analysis using multiple technologies, collaborating with stakeholders in key meetings, developing and executing self-service training programs, identifying & helping implement new technology features, working with vendors and attending leadership presentations.

On top of the various product categories we support and the multiple technologies we use, the world of digital & social media changes rapidly as AI-driven technology emerges. Therefore, a balance of technical skill, strategic thinking, proactivity, flexibility and a solution-seeking attitude is crucial for success in this role.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Works with Nestle USA’s 25+ Brand teams to democratize self-service reporting & analysis capabilities that enhance marketing communications across paid, social media, social listening, website, SEO, CRM/email, and more. Activities include reporting on website performance, overseeing A/B testing and optimization, analyzing priority campaigns for impact, building insightful dashboards, and measuring the sales impact of brand advertising. 

Leverages data-driven insights to evaluate and inform brand communication optimization strategies. Creates automated, always-on, informative, and visual dashboards and collaborates with Brand teams to enable delivery of insightful presentations that help improve engagement and effectiveness across all consumer touchpoints. 

Elevates NUSA’s understanding of the consumer experience and digital journey by leveraging 1st party, 2nd party, and 3rd party data sources to enable identification of consumer and product insights by brand teams, media teams (CRM, social, web, etc.) and Consumer Insights teams. 

Collaborates with internal departments (CRM, web strategy, paid media, social strategy, enterprise analytics) and external agency partners to operationalize data flows and establish the reporting structures needed to produce reporting and optimizations. 

Manages NUSA’s reporting requests from start to finish by building measurement/reporting frameworks, understanding stakeholder needs, visualizing data layouts, managing cross-functional IT resources, designing reporting outputs, analyzing results, and making recommendations to marketers. 
REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM EDUCATION LEVEL:

Bachelor's degree in marketing, market research, analytics, communications, business, economics, or related field1-3 years of experience in digital marketing, digital analytics, marketing analytics, business analytics, social listening or IT/data management. 
DESIRED EXPERIENCE:

General experience in digital marketing, marketing measurement, and business analytics (e.g. report generation, marketing campaign analysis, web analytics, email performance, social analytics, social listening, paid media measurement, etc.). Strong level of comfort working with the reporting platforms, technical analytics tools, and data management systems used to manipulate, transform, and analyze marketing data. Strong comfort and patience with technical data projects, including collaborating with internal/external IT personnel, understanding complex dataflows, coordinating IT resources, and working with large datasets. Experience producing dashboards and other visually compelling reports that enable efficient identification of key insights into business performance. Experience and familiarity with the research process for developing consumer, category & cultural insightsAbility to translate business needs into strategic digital analytics & social listening frameworks that can be executed & replicated across a large organizationUnderstanding of how AI can be used to support digital analytics & social listening workstreams, including prompt-writing best practices to focus the observation summarizations of AI assistantsUnderstanding of the social media landscape, dynamics of community interaction, social best practices, and digital analytics toolsExperience in the creation of persuasive PowerPoint decks to “tell the data story,” and in the presentation of these decks to senior audiences. Solid communication skills and ability to communicate data-driven findings to mid- and senior-level managers. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to network and work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders. 
ADDITIONAL PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Experience with experimentation and A/B testing of social/digital content executionsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its analytics functionalitiesExperience with Power BI to create and visualize data from disparate data sets Experience in using Google Analytics (or equivalent) and Google Tag Manager to configure website reporting, evaluate performance and derive actionable insights. Experience with social listening, social intelligence, and/or social analytics tools, such as Talkwalker, Nichefire, Yogi, Audiense, Creator IQ, Sprinklr or similarFamiliarity with the emerging LLM Listening / GEO / AEO space and the associated insights toolsBasic knowledge of coding languages or developer toolsExperience or familiarity with advanced analytics, including media mix modeling, multi-touch attribution, statistical analysis, lifetime value analysis, and sales impact studiesFamiliarity with foresight use cases, identifying and analyzing trend signals from social media that ladder up to larger cultural movements or consumer behavior shifts 
Salary: $80,029.77 to $100,585.35 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

Job Location

Job Description

Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

The Opportunity:

P&G has an opportunity for a Scientist in Baby, Feminine, and Family Care (BFF) Analytical, with focused support for Feminine Care priorities. BFF Analytical delivers measurable business outcomes through scientific leadership, advanced analytical methods, and data-driven decision-making. As a Scientist in our R&D organization, you will help translate consumer, product, and business questions into fit-for-purpose experiments, consumer-relevant measurement methods, and scientifically sound recommendations.

This role combines hands-on laboratory work, data analysis, and collaborative problem solving. You will build proficiency in analytical and measurement science while connecting fluid behavior, material properties, product design, manufacturing variation, and relevant use conditions. The ideal candidate demonstrates learning agility, attention to detail, strong scientific judgment, and clear communication, with an interest in using programming, automation, modeling, image and data analysis, or visualization to improve experimental efficiency and technical learning.

Key Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

Support measurement work for Feminine Care and other BFF priorities by translating consumer, product, or business questions into experiments and analyses with guidance from experienced scientists.Execute and improve fluid-management methods that quantify acquisition, distribution, retention, rewet, and leakage performance under relevant use conditions, documenting procedures and results in accordance with laboratory standards.Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret fluid, chemical, materials, image, or product-performance data; identify trends, data-quality issues, and questions requiring further investigation.Participate in method development, validation, troubleshooting, digitization, and transfer activities, including laboratory automation, programming, statistical analysis, modeling, image and data analysis, or visualization as appropriate.Collaborate with BFF Analytical colleagues and cross-functional partners in Product Research, Product Development, Modeling, Process & Engineering, Product Supply, and Commercial functions to execute measurement plans and contribute scientific evidence to product and process decisions.Maintain safe, organized, and compliant laboratory practices while following applicable procedures, data-integrity expectations, stewardship requirements, and quality systems.Build technical capability through coaching, feedback, literature review, training, and hands-on experience, progressively taking ownership of defined technical tasks or workstreams.

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Education: Ph.D. in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Physical Sciences, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific field.Laboratory and analytical foundation: Demonstrated ability to conduct laboratory experiments, maintain accurate records, and interpret scientific data through doctoral research, internships, or related experience.Scientific problem solving: Ability to apply scientific fundamentals to defined problems, recognize unexpected results, seek guidance when appropriate, and draw well-supported conclusions from available evidence.Communication and collaboration: Clear written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain methods, results, and limitations to technical and cross-functional partners.Execution: Demonstrated learning agility, attention to detail, collaboration, and ability to deliver assigned work against defined priorities and timelines while following safety, quality, stewardship, and data-integrity requirements.Location: Ability to work on-site at P&G’s Mason Business & Innovation Center in Cincinnati, Ohio, as required for laboratory-based work 4-5 days per week.

Preferred Qualifications:

Relevant technical experience: Exposure to method development and validation, materials characterization, fluid or transport phenomena, porous or absorbent materials, or consumer-relevant measurement.Data and digital tools: Experience with experimental design, statistics, programming, laboratory automation, image and data analysis, data visualization, modeling, chemometrics, or machine learning.Technical storytelling: Ability to integrate complex analytical findings into clear, decision-oriented scientific narratives.

Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

The Commercial Finance Director is the lead Finance representative on the Commercial Leadership Team and owns the Finance agenda for the Commercial organization. As the strategic finance partner to the VP of Commercial, this role provides independent financial leadership, constructive challenge, and an outside-in perspective to shape sourcing strategy and decisions.

The role provides financial leadership across a multi-billion-dollar direct material portfolio and is accountable for translating commodity markets, supplier economics, internal performance, and business plans into clear actions that create sustainable value. This leader guides the Commercial Finance team and establishes the Finance agenda across value creation, productivity governance, supplier economics, forecasting, planning, portfolio decision support, risk management, financial stewardship, and talent development.

The role connects Commercial with Portfolio Growth Teams (PGTs), partnering with PGT leaders and Finance to bring forward-looking perspectives on material cost drivers, supplier and commodity exposure, risks, opportunities, and sourcing trade-offs into portfolio decisions. The role helps ensure sourcing implications are understood early and reflected in growth plans, innovation choices, margin delivery, and portfolio priorities.

Reporting and insight foundations are well established. The next evolution is to use these capabilities more strategically by strengthening the productivity pipeline, improving decision quality, deepening supplier and cost insights, and delivering targeted digital enhancements that make analysis faster, more predictive, and easier to act on.

This role sits at the intersection of Commercial strategy, sourcing execution, portfolio growth, and financial performance. It offers the opportunity to influence some of the business’s most important sourcing and portfolio decisions, shape the value creation agenda across a multi-billion-dollar spend base, partner directly with senior leaders, and build the next generation of Finance talent. Success requires balancing external market dynamics, supplier economics, productivity delivery, supply resilience, and growth ambitions to enable profitable and sustainable growth.

What are we looking for?

Proven finance leadership experience in commercial, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or FP&A, with accountability for a significant business or spend portfolio.Strong business partnering skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively, and translate analysis into clear decisions and actions.Strong financial grounding across analysis, modeling, forecasting, planning, performance management, and controls.Commercial judgment and curiosity about external markets, supplier economics, and sourcing dynamics.Experience leading and developing teams, setting priorities, building capability, and creating meaningful development opportunities.Clear, concise executive communication skills, with judgment to focus leaders on the most material risks, opportunities, and decisions.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent qualification is preferred.

What Will Be Your Key Responsibilities?

Commercial Finance Leadership and Business Partnership:

Serve as the lead Finance representative on the Commercial Leadership Team, owning the Finance agenda for Commercial and bringing an enterprise perspective to sourcing and business decisions.Partner with the VP of Commercial and senior Commercial leaders to shape strategy through insight, constructive challenge, and clear financial implications.Connect Commercial decisions to enterprise, PGT, and financial priorities, including growth, margin, cost, cash, service, quality, resilience, and sustainable value creation.

Value Creation, Productivity, and Supplier Economics:

Lead financial governance of the primes productivity agenda, including pipeline sufficiency, initiative valuation, phasing, risk assessment, validation, and performance tracking.Translate commodity markets, supplier economics, industry dynamics, and macroeconomic trends into clear implications for Mars.Partner with Commercial leaders to identify new sources of value across categories, suppliers, specifications, demand, terms, working capital, and sourcing models.

Portfolio Insights & Decision Support:

Partner with PGT leaders and PGT Finance to translate sourcing strategies, commodity outlooks, supplier economics, and material cost exposure into portfolio-level financial drivers, risks, and opportunities.Connect PGT priorities back to Commercial category strategies and help align sourcing actions, productivity plans, and supplier decisions with portfolio needs.Provide clear scenarios and trade-offs so PGTs can balance growth, profitability, supply resilience, quality, and longer-term value creation.

Forecasting, Planning, and Performance Management:

Lead the primes forecasting and planning agenda, ensuring assumptions are transparent, appropriately challenged, and translated into clear financial outcomes.Guide analysis of commodity inflation or deflation, productivity, mix, timing, and other drivers, with clear visibility of risks and opportunities.Lead performance reviews with Commercial and Finance leaders and convert insights into decisions, actions, owners, and follow-through.

Financial Stewardship, Controls, and Digital Enablement:

Maintain effective oversight of retained period-close activities within the Commercial Finance team while keeping the role primarily focused on forward-looking leadership and value creation.Ensure accurate financial results, strong governance over assumptions and savings recognition, and timely escalation of material financial risks.Strengthen reporting, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled enhancements where they improve decision quality, forecasting agility, or efficiency.

Team Leadership and Talent Development:

Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Finance team, setting clear priorities, standards, and accountability.Build capability in financial analysis, commercial acumen, storytelling, business partnering, digital tools, and value creation.Organize team capacity and ways of working to focus resources on the highest-value priorities while delivering core financial responsibilities.

rows.descriptionText:
Head of Analytics | Last Mile | Hybrid Working | London OR Hatfield HQ

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About The Role

As the Head of Analytics for Last Mile, you will take full ownership of the insight agenda for one of the most operationally intensive domains at Ocado. Last Mile oversees the critical final stage of our operation - ensuring the right orders reach the right customers on time - and encompasses delivery routing, fleet operations, slot management, and performance tracking across our global partners.

This is a highly influential, cross-functional position sitting on the Data & Analytics leadership team. While our underlying AI capability is already advanced, this role is less about inventing the technology and heavily focused on the human and operational element: turning advanced capabilities into tangible business value, driving stakeholder adoption, and bringing together teams that do not normally work closely together.

You will drive delivery through influence rather than direct authority, collaborating closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, and Partner Success, as well as peer Heads of Analytics in Fulfilment and Ecommerce. Additionally, you will ensure solutions are built in a way that serves Ocado Retail today, with a view to potentially releasing successful solutions to external Ocado partners in the future.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Last-Mile Efficiency: Conceptualize opportunities, develop strategic approaches, and pull together the right cross-functional teams to optimize current operations.Deliver Operational Value: Drive initiatives focused on turning advanced analytical/AI capabilities into operational reality, including improving store operations, maximizing fulfillment efficiency, and optimizing the use of chiller totes and capacity.Enable Better Decision-Making: Enable a higher volume of orders to be successfully fulfilled through better operational and data-driven decisions.Lead and Develop the Team: Manage the Last Mile analytics team, establishing clear standards for work prioritization, scoping, and communication.Nurture Talent: Oversee the technical and communication development of analysts to ensure insights are actionable, highly impactful, and easily understood by the business.Foster an Experimentation Culture: Champion a culture of innovation and experimentation, negotiating decision rights, setting clear evidence standards, and encouraging testing over instinctual decision-making.Manage AI Foundations: Own the semantic and context layers for Last Mile, ensuring business definitions and metric logic remain accurate so AI-generated outputs align seamlessly with real-world operations.Optimise Feedback Loops: Work with the central AI enablement function to design and maintain tight feedback loops between AI outputs and ground truth, helping stakeholders adopt and use these tools confidently.

Essential

What We're Looking For:

Complex Stakeholder Management & Influence: A background in management consultancy or a similarly complex multi-stakeholder environment. Proven ability to operate in complex environments, structure ambiguous problems, create alignment around a shared vision, and comfortably challenge existing thinking at a senior/VP level.Influence Without Authority: Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of driving change and bringing together disparate teams through pure influence rather than direct reporting lines.High Energy & Change Leadership: Energetic, charismatic, and collaborative mindset with experience leading an analytics or change function through substantive operational methodology shifts.Tech & AI Landscape Literacy: A strong, grounded understanding of current AI tools and data platforms. The ability to distinguish genuinely useful solutions from noise and successfully translate complex AI/data capabilities into commercial, operational business value.Analytical Foundations: Solid analytical foundations necessary to set team standards for experimentation, metric architecture, and validating model efficacy alongside Data Science partners.

Nice to Haves

Domain Familiarity: Experience within operational, logistics, or last-mile environments, bringing strong real-world context to data analysis (highly valued, but a nice-to-have rather than essential).Data Science Exposure: History of working alongside data science or machine learning functions, understanding how to bridges analytics and operational modeling.Modern Data Tooling Experience: Exposure to semantic layer tooling, data cataloguing, or AI evaluation frameworks.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

Time To Recharge

25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave

Financial Support

Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.

Commuter Perks

Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

Exclusive Discounts

15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Reporting to the Director of Analytics, you will be the embedded analytics lead for a new EA SPORTS title in development. This is a senior role focused on building analytics from the ground up: defining success metrics, shaping telemetry, modeling game systems, and helping the team make better product decisions from early testing through launch and beyond. You will have a growth path towards analytics leadership as the title and team scale.

Responsibilities

Build the analytics foundation for a new EA SPORTS title, including measurement frameworks, telemetry requirements, metric definitions, and insight roadmaps.Own and execute the analytics roadmap from user tests through launch and live service; translate product milestones into clear analytics and data deliverables.Partner with Product, Design, and User Research teams to conduct analysis and modeling of player behavior, progression systems, retention systems, and monetization systems.Define telemetry, data quality, and reporting requirements; partner with Data Engineering and Data Architecture to ensure trusted, scalable data and reporting.Develop the analytical foundations needed to support experimentation, segmentation, and personalization.Elevate how insights are used across feature development, user tests, launch readiness, and live-service evolution.

Qualifications

7+ years of professional experience informing product strategy with data analysis in gaming or adjacent digital products with high independence.Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or related discipline).Expert–level SQL proficiency with experience extracting insights from complex datasets.Experience designing self-service dashboards using Tableau, Looker, or other similar tools.Experience using Python or similar for analysis, modeling, segmentation, or experimentation.Experience with free-to-play live service games, player retention, or economy systems.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. rows.title: Client Success Research Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Make Your Mark at Ipsos

Are you naturally curious, analytical and passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences? Do you enjoy working with data, building client relationships and uncovering insights that drive action? Join our Channel Performance team and help some of the world's leading brands improve their customer experience.

About The Role

As a Research Executive within Ipsos Channel Performance (ChP), you'll play a key role in delivering mystery shopping programmes that help clients understand and improve customer experience and operational performance. Channel Performance is the UK's largest provider of mystery shopping services, working with leading organisations across retail, hospitality and telecommunications.

You'll be responsible for the day-to-day management of a portfolio of client programmes, ensuring projects are delivered accurately, on time and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with clients, operations teams and mystery shoppers, you'll help solve problems, streamline processes and turn complex data into meaningful insights.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a career in research and client management. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of industries, develop strong analytical and stakeholder management skills, and work alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative and supportive environment where your work will have a direct impact on client decision-making.

About You

Essential Skills

Excellent attention to detail.Strong analytical skills and confidence working with large datasets.Ability to identify key findings and translate data into meaningful insights.Strong organisational and time management skills.Confident communicator with the ability to build effective client relationships.Ability to follow established processes while proactively identifying improvements.Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.Proficiency in AI use and adoption to enhance day-to-day tasks. 

Desirable Skills

Previous experience within mystery shopping, customer experience or market research.Understanding of retail, hospitality or telecommunications sectors.Passion for understanding people, customer behaviour and market trends.Experience producing client-facing reports and presentations.Ability to remain calm and effective in a fast-paced environment.

Behaviours

Aligned To Ipsos' Ignite Behaviours, You'll Demonstrate

Analytical thinking.Curiosity and continuous learning.Resilience, flexibility and agility.Creative problem-solving.Empathy and active listening.Strong customer and service orientation.Motivation and self-awareness. 

Benefits

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you as an individual. Our standard benefits include 25 days annual leave, pension contribution, income protection and life assurance. In addition, there are a range health & wellbeing, financial benefits and professional development opportunities.

We have a hybrid approach to work and ask people to be in the office or with clients for 3 days per week. We appreciate you may have commitments outside of work and will consider flexible working applications - please highlight what you are looking for when you make your application.

We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment and ensuring we have diversity of people and views. We recognise that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to better reflect and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We are proud to be a member of the Disability Confident scheme, certified as a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. We provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process.

Your application will be reviewed by someone from our Talent Team who will be in touch either way to let you know the outcome.

Ready to have an impact? Apply now!

About Us

Ipsos is one of the world’s largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. And we are proud of our continuous efforts in making Ipsos the best place to work!

About The Team

The Channel Performance Service Line is home to the largest mystery shopping agency in the world.We complete over one million shops every year in 100+ countries across all industry segments and organization sizes.We also offer Geolocation Surveys, Site Audits & Installations, and foundational research within our portfolio of services.Our purpose is to help our clients improve their business performance across all channels in which they serve their customers – brick and mortar retail, digital e-commerce, and contact centers.We do this by helping them size channel opportunities, measure the delivery of brand promises, and drive compliance and sales conversion across these channels.

rows.title: Data Scientist (Bayesian Inference)
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator is seeking a Data Scientist (Bayesian Modeling) to help build, enhance, and scale data science services across our rapidly evolving data platform. You’ll work on initiatives that turn massive proprietary datasets into impactful, production-grade solutions..

This is a growth-track, product-focused role. You’ll collaborate with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to learn how customer needs translate into data-driven products, analytics methodologies, and new offerings that drive measurable business impact.

How You'll Spend Your Time:

Contribute to the implementation and delivery of Bayesian and probabilistic modeling pipelines, from methodology research through production, with guidance from senior team members Execute on individual tickets independently and take on small epics with mentorship and guidance Work closely with Product, GTM, Data, and Engineering to turn models into reliable, production-grade solutions the business can depend on Actively participate in the team's learning culture (journal club, analysis reviews, standups) and seek feedback to continually level up your craft in Bayesian methods and reasoning about uncertainty Communicate methods, results, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Strong foundation in Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling — e.g. hierarchical / multilevel models, state-space and time-series models, graphical models, MCMC/HMC, variational and other approximate inferenceExperience or coursework applying probabilistic/Bayesian methods to real-world datasets, with a strong curiosity to learn production-grade standards Comfort reasoning about uncertainty, calibration, and model validation Facility with large or structured datasets and the computational side of inference at scale Strong Python, and fluency in a modern probabilistic-programming and numerical-computing stack — NumPyro, PyMC, Stan, JAX, dynamax, or similar. We hire on the ideas, not on exact tooling Demonstrated interest in shipping statistical models into production systems and writing maintainable code BS to PhD in Statistics, Math, Economics, Physics, CS, or a related quantitative field 0-2 years of relevant experience or recent graduate with strong quantitative project work Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences 

Nice to Haves:

Diagnosing and debugging large Bayesian models — convergence and divergence issues, pinning down which part of a big model is misbehaving, and knowing which inference method to reach for Weighting a non-representative survey or panel sample up to a known population, and a feel for where those adjustments break down Hierarchical models spanning multiple crossed or overlapping groupings — relationships that bridge hierarchies, not just a single nested tree Experience with graph or network models, or modeling relational / graph-structured data Measurement-error modeling, or reconciling multiple imperfect data sources CPG / FMCG / retail experience, or work with user-level purchase or panel data 

What We Offer:

An inclusive and collaborative company culture - we work in an open, transparent environment to get things done and adapt to the changing needs as they come An opportunity to have an impact in a technologically data-driven company that’s changing the market research industry and getting rave reviews Ownership of data solutions Market-competitive total compensation package Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences and employee resources groups Regular hackathons to build your own projects and Engineering and Data Science Lunch and Learns Great benefits package including health/vision/dental, unlimited PTO, flexible schedule, internally quiet focus time, recharge days, 401K matching, travel reimbursement, and more

rows.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, C++ Distributed Systems| Hybrid: Chicago, IL
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

Role Overview

We are seeking Senior Staff Engineers to drive design, evolution, and execution of our next-generation, massively parallel processing (MPP) clustered database engine (Whitebox) that currently powers large-scale retail and consumer analytics solutions across Circana clients in 22+ countries and serving millions of queries every day in real-time against massive data sets . This is a highly technical role for an expert who bridges the gap between High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Big Data systems engineering and low-latency machine learning infrastructure and involves database internals, distributed systems, performance engineering, data processing at scale.

In this role, you will be one of the primary designers and developer responsible for building low-latency, high-throughput distributed database kernels. You will design bare-metal optimized software layers, ensuring our database product fully exploits modern multi-core, vectorized hardware and distributed network fabrics to process terabyte/petabyte-scale datasets and where appropriate, seamlessly executes highly performant analytics and in-database ML inference directly on relational and the occasional vector datasets.

Job Responsibilities

Architecture & Design: Play a key role in core architectural choices and roadmap for our distributed database kernel, including query execution engines, custom/hybrid columnar storage layers, distributed transaction managers, and cluster coordination protocols. Low-Level Development: Write, optimize, and maintain highly performant, production-ready backend code utilizing modern C++ (C++20/23). Parallel Execution Planning: Architect MPP execution engines that distribute, schedule, and execute queries across several dozens to hundreds of nodes using MPI and hybrid OpenMP models. Hardware Optimization: Profile and eliminate execution bottlenecks by implementing explicit SIMD vectorization (AVX-512, ARM Neon, SVE) and ensuring absolute cache locality (L1/L2/L3). Distributed Memory & Networks: Design ultra-low latency cluster communication subsystems utilizing RDMA, RoCE, or kernel-bypass tech (DPDK). In-Database ML Framework Design: Architect and implement a native, highly performant, zero-copy ML execution framework directly inside the MPP engine to eliminate data serialization and transport bottlenecks between the database and external AI pipelines. Functional & High-Performance Algorithms: Develop mathematically rigorous, cache-oblivious, and highly vectorized algorithms for real-time statistical computations, matrix operations/manipulations on clustered dataVector & Embedding Infrastructure: Design and optimize or embed/reference distributed high-dimensional vector storage subsystems, custom SIMD-accelerated indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, IVF-PQ), and parallelized approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms. Be comfortable working in a cross country/multi time zone team of elite systems engineers, implementing as well as conducting rigorous peer design and development reviewsCollaborate with cross-functional teams in defining and developing new platform capabilities. Actively participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical mentoring. Investigate and resolve complex performance and scalability issues. 

Required Technical Qualifications

Minimum - 4 years Computer Science engineering degree from a reputed institute. Masters in HPC (high performance computing) and Bigdata engineering areas preferred for Senior staff engineer and above rolesModern C++ Expertise: 8+ years of production experience writing hands-on, low-level systems in C++ (C++17/20/23 preferred). Mastery of template metaprogramming, concepts, coroutines, and custom memory allocators is key. HPC Parallelism: Very good to expert-level knowledge of cluster-scale distributed programming using MPI (Message Passing Interface) paired with shared-memory thread-level programming via OpenMP and MapReduce frameworks. Hardware-Aware Engineering: Documented experience with microarchitectural optimization, loop vectorization, pointer-aliasing constraints, and manual SIMD intrinsics programming. Concurrency Mechanics: Deep understanding of OS internals, memory barriers, lock-free data structures, and atomics (std::atomic). Database Internals: Practical experience designing core database subsystems (e.g., vectorized query operators, LSM-trees, B-trees, custom buffer pools, columnar serialization frameworks and query plan optimizers). Strong debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in one or more leading memory and compute monitoring/performance tools (such as Valgrind, Purify, Intel/AMD/ARM diagnostics etc.)

Bonus Qualifications

Track record contributing to open-source or work experience on proprietary distributed engines (e.g., ClickHouse, DuckDB, Doris, CockroachDB, RocksDB, ScyllaDB, or Velox). Experience with cloud-native distributed, elastic environments, object storage tiering (S3/GCS), or zero-copy networking. Experience integrating heterogeneous acceleration (NVIDIA CUDA / ROCm) into big data workloads and hybrid CPU/GPU setups. Vector & Graph Algorithmic experience: Experience building or modifying high-performance vector index/search engines, graph-based indices, or localized quantization frameworks. Functional domain awareness – CPG, Retail, Pharma verticals

What We Offer

Work on the bleeding edge of data infrastructure, tackling next gen big data engineering problems to support real time querying and analytics against some of the largest data sets at high concurrencyChallenging engineering problems - all the way from functional/data science algorithm implementations on a HPC setup to bare metal/close to OS kernel level programming involving handling of hundreds of billions of records to support real-time analytics at scale. Plenty of valuable exposure to broader BI/Analytics/Bigdata ecosystem including great opportunity to functionally better understand CPG, Retail and related domains. Highly competitive compensation package (Base, Bonus)

Stimulating work environment and a great Circana work culture that allows members to bring their best daily.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid: Chicago, IL

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is up to $190,000 USD.

This job is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Lead Product Designer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What’s the role?

As a Design team member at Bilt, you’ll be instrumental in shaping the experiences we build and how our users interact with them. You’ll be reporting to our Head of Product Design and leading the design initiatives within your dedicated pod, creating enterprise and consumer-facing experiences that align with both user needs and business objectives.

In this role, you will… 

Own product development end to end, from initial concept through shipping and beyondBuild wireframes and prototypes that convey your ideas and communicate your solutions to the broader team & stakeholdersConduct research and utilize data to inform product decisions while keeping the customer at the center of everythingWork alongside engineers to ensure the product is implemented to exacting standards and a high level of polishShip, measure, and improve the product based on quantitative and qualitative feedbackIdentify future opportunities, working as a thought partner to the Product, Marketing, and Engineering teamsDefine our design system and scale it thoughtfully so as to maintain consistency and cohesiveness throughout our products

Who You Are

You have great instincts about what users want and how they think, but you aren’t afraid to get the data you need to make product decisions.You’re a storyteller, both verbally and visually, and you can create insightful user stories and prototypes that align the team around product features.You don’t just deliver mockups—you work with other teams to deliver a holistic user experience that encompasses technical logic, edge cases, accessibility, product marketing, and success metrics.You’re not an engineer, but you know their lingo, and you have the chops to balance product scope with engineering effort.You can work fast and loose if needed, but you also understand when process and structure are necessary, and you have ideas about how to implement them.

In Terms Of Qualifications, We’re Seeking

5+ years of product design or UX design experience, or combined product management and design experienceA portfolio showing high-quality, impactful UX, UI, and product workMastery in wireframing, interaction, and prototyping tools, including Figma.Experience in UX Analytics and Research is a plusExperience in Product Management is a plusExperience in Front End development is a plus

Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Lead Product Designer is $160,000 - 215,000 and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

rows.title: Circana Scholars Program - Experiential Learning (2027 Academic Year)
rows.descriptionText:
What is Circana Scholars Program?

Circana offers an experiential learning initiative designed to introduce students to a career in market research and analytics. Through this program, participants gain access to scholarships, technical training, professional development workshops, executive panel discussions, mentorship, and a final project to showcase your skills and knowledge. 

Program Highlights: 

Learn how to leverage Circana’s consumer solutions and analytics to address real-world business challenges and market opportunities. Translate data into actionable insights that drive business performance for Circana’s clients. Develop and present a final case study, showcasing insights derived from data analysis. Engage with peers and industry experts to explore topics such as navigating the workforce as a person of color, jump starting your career, and giving back to your community. 

What You’ll Gain as a Participant:

We are committed to ensuring every participant benefits from:

Financial support: A scholarship to assist with your education. Industry knowledge: deeper understanding of the market research and analytics industry, as well as the clients we serve. Real-world experience: Hands-on work with a real-world case study. Skill development: Training in technical tools and essential behavioral skills critical for career success. Networking opportunities: Access to mentors and industry professionals, fostering connections that extend beyond the program. 

Who We're Looking For: 

We are dynamic individuals from diverse backgrounds, who are eager to jumpstart their careers, get hands- on experiences, and make a positive impact.

Ideal candidates are:  

Juniors graduating from 2027 to 2029Interested in pursuing careers in Insights, Data Analytics, Paid Media, Market Research, CPG or RetailWillingness to embrace new technologies and a passion for leveraging innovative solutions to drive business value. Available to attend program virtual meetings on the following dates:Saturdays (January – May) from 9 a.m. – 10:30 a.m. CT (10 a.m. – 11:30 a.m. ET) Fridays (June – August) from 10 a.m. – 11:30 a.m. CT (11 a.m. – 12:30 p.m. ET) 
How To Apply:

To apply, please submit your resume along with one of the following:

 A brief cover letter explaining why you want to participate in Circana Scholars Program.  A letter of recommendation from a current or past professor, mentor, or supervisor. 

You can apply for the Circana Scholars Program through our career website.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator’s Data Science team provides statistical and methodological leadership across the organization, developing the methodologies, tools, and data products that support our products.

This is a wide-ranging applied data science role focused primarily on the consumer purchase panel underlying our largest products, with opportunities to contribute to other complex data science initiatives across Numerator’s broader product portfolio. The work combines applied statistics, data investigation, methodology development, and practical implementation. Many of the questions we tackle do not have a single observable right answer, requiring us to combine statistical evidence, product context, and subject-matter judgment to understand tradeoffs and determine whether a solution improves the product as a whole. As your expertise grows, you will take on increasingly complex work and have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, lead projects, improve team practices, and shape how we work.

How You’ll Spend Your Time

Design and implement statistical methodologies that improve the representativeness, stability, and quality of Numerator’s products. Develop data science solutions to problems involving consumer behavior, panel composition, and data quality using techniques such as sampling, weighting, statistical modeling, classification, predictive modeling, anomaly detection, and optimization. Build scalable Python and SQL solutions, internal tools, and data products that turn statistical methodologies into reliable production workflows. Develop metrics, monitoring, and validation frameworks to evaluate system performance and identify unexpected or unintended behavior. Contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from problem definition and exploration through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing evaluation. Work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Operations, and business partners to shape requirements and develop solutions that are both statistically sound and practical to use. Communicate methodologies, findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

A bachelor’s or advanced degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Physics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Two to five years of industry experience developing and delivering data science solutions. A strong foundation in applied statistics, with experience applying statistical modeling, optimization, or other quantitative methods to real-world data problems. Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience developing reusable, well-structured code and working with large, complex datasets. Comfort working through open-ended problems, investigating unexpected results, and developing solutions with guidance and collaboration, along with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners. Familiarity with survey research or consumer panels—including sampling, weighting, bias correction, imputation, or other methods used to improve representativeness—is helpful but not required. Experience working with user-level or behavioral data is helpful, as is exposure to production data science workflows and tools such as Snowflake, AWS, Airflow, or GitHub. Familiarity with AI-powered tools and workflows, with an interest in applying emerging technologies to improve productivity, learning, and outcomes. 

What We Offer

An inclusive and collaborative company culture—we work in an open environment while working together to get things done and adapt to changing needs as they arise. A market-competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences, and employee resource groups. A great benefits package including health, vision, and dental coverage; a Personal Spending Account; unlimited PTO; flexible scheduling; 401(k) matching; travel reimbursement; and more.

rows.title: Director, Data Platform Engineering
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

The Director, Data & AI - Data Engineering & Platforms is responsible for defining, refining and executing Domino's enterprise data strategy, data platform roadmap, and data engineering operating model. This leader oversees enterprise data platforms, data engineering, enterprise data products, data quality engineering, data base administration, and data operations capabilities that enable trusted, scalable, and secure data across the organization.

This role leads the teams responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving the data foundations that power analytics, reporting, operational systems, predictive AI, and generative AI solutions. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the Director ensures Domino's data assets are reliable, discoverable, and ready to support growing enterprise demand for data-driven decision making.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership

Define and evolve the enterprise data platform, engineering, and operations strategy. Develop and manage a multi-year roadmap aligned to business priorities and technology modernization goals. Drive a data-as-a-product culture focused on trusted, reusable, and business-aligned data assets. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders on data platform investments and capabilities. Establish goals, operating metrics, and performance measures that drive continuous improvement and business value. 

Data Engineering & Platforms

Lead the strategy, architecture, and operation of Domino's enterprise data platforms and engineering capabilities. Establish standards for reliability, scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost optimization. Lead the design and delivery of scalable batch, streaming, and real-time data solutions. Drive engineering best practices across data modeling, software development, testing, CI/CD, automation, and observability. Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies that improve engineering productivity, platform capabilities, and operational effectiveness. 

Enterprise Data Products

Own the enterprise data product strategy and roadmap for foundational data assets consumed across the organization. Establish standards for data product ownership, lifecycle management, reliability, discoverability, and operational support. Partner with analytics, application, and business teams to develop reusable and scalable enterprise data products. Enable self-service analytics and data consumption through consistent, trusted, and well-documented data assets. Measure success through adoption, quality, reliability, and business impact. 

Data Foundations for Analytics & AI

Ensure enterprise data platforms and data products provide trusted data foundations for analytics, predictive AI, and generative AI solutions. Develop and operate feature-serving capabilities that support machine learning and predictive modeling workloads. Develop and operate context-serving capabilities that support enterprise knowledge retrieval and generative AI experiences. Partner with Data Science, AI Engineering, Architecture, and Analytics teams to support evolving data consumption patterns. Drive investments in metadata, lineage, observability, and data quality that improve trust in downstream analytics and AI solutions. 

Data Quality & Operations

Lead the Data Quality Engineering and Data Operations functions. Establish enterprise standards for monitoring, validation, reconciliation, issue management, and operational support. Drive operational excellence through incident management, root cause analysis, automation, and continuous improvement. Define and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, and platform health metrics. Partner with business governance, security, compliance, and analytics stakeholders to ensure platforms support approved enterprise policies, business definitions, and regulatory requirements. 

People Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of managers, engineers, and technical specialists. Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and technical excellence. Recruit, retain, and develop top talent while creating clear career growth opportunities. Manage team budgets, resource allocation, vendor relationships, and strategic investments. Promote continuous learning and adoption of modern engineering practices across the organization. 

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or related field. 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, cloud data technologies, or enterprise data management. 5+ years of leadership experience managing engineering, platform, or technology teams. Proven experience building and operating enterprise-scale data platforms and data products. Strong expertise with cloud-based data platforms, modern data architecture patterns, and large-scale distributed data processing. Experience leading data quality, operational support, and platform reliability initiatives. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across technical and business audiences. Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology solutions and roadmaps. 

Preferred Qualifications

rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What’s the role?

Bilt's organic social presence is how millions of people meet us — in their feeds, in their neighborhoods, and in the middle of culture. We're hiring an Organic Social Lead to run the execution of that presence: a director-level producer who owns our organic social output end to end, led by Instagram, with TikTok as a growing second pillar and support across LinkedIn and X.

This is a hands-on senior seat on our Brand & Comms pod. You'll concept, produce, write, and publish great content every week — working daily with product marketing, comms, design, and our product video/paid team, and directing a bench of freelance creatives. It starts as an individual contributor role with a real path to building a team over time.

In this role, you will… 

Own Bilt's organic social calendar end to end — concept, produce, write, and publish great content every weekLead Instagram as our flagship social channel, build out TikTok as the second pillar, and support LinkedIn and XDrive creative concepting — develop posts, formats, and series rooted in what's happening in culture right nowDirect and manage freelance creatives — designers, editors, makers — to keep weekly output consistently highPartner with product marketing, comms, design, and the product video/paid team to ship social alongside launches and campaignsWrite captions and social-first copy, with editorial oversight from the Senior Content DirectorOwn publishing and community management — posting, comments, and channel health day to dayBuild the workflows, formats, and content series that grow Bilt's organic presence, and lead your own initiatives and campaignsTrack what breaks through, read the performance, and fold those learnings into the next round of concepts

In Terms Of Qualifications, We’re Seeking

Must Have:Proof you've taken social content from 0 to 1 — a channel, program, or body of work you built, not just maintainedA portfolio of social content you directly produced that broke through the noise — reach, engagement, or cultural impact you can point toDeep, current fluency in Instagram and working fluency in TikTok; familiarity with LinkedIn and XStrong producer and project management instincts — you've run a content pipeline and shipped on a weekly cadenceExperience directing external creatives — freelancers, designers, editors — from concept to shipped postSharp social copy skills — you write your own captionsComfortable owning comments and day-to-day community presenceAble to work fully in-office in NYCNice to Have:Strong design background — great taste, a rich reference library, a sense of where culture is moving; hands-on design skills or experience art-directing designersVideo editing background (Premiere, CapCut, After Effects, or similar)Experience at consumer, lifestyle, media, or culture-adjacent brandsFamiliarity with social publishing and analytics tooling
Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Organic Social Lead is $140,000 - 160,000 and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

rows.descriptionText:
Company Description

See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

Overview

How You’ll Make an Impact 

As a Lead, Client Success, you will act as a pivotal individual contributor, owning client & agency relationships and driving the strategic adoption of Epsilon’s person-first digital media solutions. You will collaborate closely with Epsilon Sales, Publicis agency partners, and internal cross-functional teams to transform client business objectives into high-performing media realities.

Responsibilities

This is an ideal role for a media professional who wants to be at the center of the action bridging the gap between high-level strategy, pitching new products and ideas that meet client objectives as well as hands-on execution. You’ll have the opportunity to:

Partner with Client Leadership/Sales Team to identify and advance optimization, upsell, and digital media growth opportunities. Synthesize performance insights and support QBRs and strategic readouts. Connect campaign results to broader business goals and future investment planning. Develop innovative, data-driven media proposals and campaigns that leverage Epsilon’s industry-leading identity products. Directly influence Epsilon’s growth by ensuring delivery excellence and operational health. 

Qualifications

Who You Are

You are a client-focused professional with a passion for marketing, client success, and digital media. You excel at getting things done, staying organized, and building strong working client and internal relationships. You are comfortable working with data to monitor performance and communicate insights, and you have a strong attention to detail that helps ensure high-quality execution.

You’re eager to learn how strategy and execution come together to drive results. You’re proactive about identifying issues early, escalating appropriately, and partnering across teams to support client outcomes and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring With You

Bachelor’s Degree from a four-year college or university.8+ years of experience in digital marketing, media, analytics, or client success.Experience in developing, nurturing and managing client relationships.Proven track record of driving and maintaining revenue growth with clientsExceptional organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Comfort working with performance data to monitor campaign health and identify trends.Ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholdersExcellent communication and interpersonal skills.Highly organized with a strong attention to detail. 

Why You Might Stand Out From Other Talent

Direct experience within the digital media landscape, specifically with platform-based execution.A self-starter who recognizes potential challenges early and approaches them with a proactive outlook.A history of building strong client and internal partnerships to drive collective delivery excellence. 

Additional Information

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together. We’re a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so EPIC:

Our Culture: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/our-culture-epsilon

Life at Epsilon: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/epic-blog

Epsilon Has Five Values That Define Our Culture And Guide Us As We Create Value For Our Clients, Our People And Consumers. We Seek Candidates Who Align With Our Company Values, Demonstrate Them And Make Them Meaningful In Their Day-to-day Work

Act with integrity. We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.Work together to win together. We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.Innovate with purpose. We shape the market with big ideas that drive big outcomes.Respect all voices. We embrace differences and foster a culture of connection and belonging.Empower with accountability. We trust each other to own and deliver on common goals.

Because You Matter

with expertise in query optimisation for large datasetsExpertise in developing APIs and robust backend services, with strong programming skills in Python, Java, and/or ScalaExceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to work independently or collaborativelyExcellent verbal and written communication skillsStrong sense of ownership in driving projects from inception to user adoptionExperience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and containerisation tools like Docker and Kubernetes (preferred)Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Jenkins and Terraform (preferred)Experience with building agentic AI systems to automate decision-making and enhance analytics workflows (preferred)Experience in AdTech and advertising data platforms (preferred) What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.
