We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. rows.title: Lead Customer Journey Manager - Data & AI Transformation
rows.descriptionText: Job Title: Lead Customer Journey Manager - Data & AI TransformationLocation: BristolHours: Full timeWorking Pattern: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of your time, at our Bristol office. About This OpportunityWe're on a mission to transform how we use data across our Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) division. As part of our CIB Data Labs team, you'll work in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment that brings together architecture, engineering and business communities. You'll play a key role in driving innovation and delivering impactful solutions that make a real difference to our customers. As a Lead Customer Journey Manager, you'll play a critical role in product development, working with Product Owners and multidisciplinary teams to understand, measure and orchestrate end-to-end client and colleague journeys. You'll combine strong customer journey expertise with an understanding of processes, systems, data flows and integration points to translate customer, business and regulatory needs into data and technology-enabled solutions. You'll find opportunities to simplify processes, remove inefficiencies and improve outcomes through the effective use of Data, Analytics and AI. Working across Product, CTO, CDAIO, Commercial Architecture, Data and Operations, you'll ensure journey intent, process design, data requirements and AI solutions remain aligned. Acting as the bridge between business and technology, you'll shape prioritisation decisions, orchestrate delivery across functional boundaries and ensure design choices deliver scalable, efficient, compliant and measurable outcomes. You'll also promote effective data stewardship, ensuring the data required to support journeys and Data & AI use cases is clearly defined, understood, governed and connected to authoritative sources and strategic data products. This is your chance to lead the migration of our data capabilities to the cloud, build trusted data foundations and unlock the potential of AI across our business. What You'll Be DoingLead the definition and optimisation of end-to-end client and colleague journeys, identifying where Data, Analytics and AI can improve decision-making, customer outcomes, operational efficiency and business performance.Translate business, customer and regulatory requirements into Data, Analytics and AI use cases, ensuring priorities are aligned to strategic business outcomes and measurable value.Define and maintain journey, process, data and integration maps, creating a single view of business processes, data flows, systems, controls and dependencies required to enable transformation.Partner with Product, CTO, CDAIO and Operations teams to understand shared Data & AI capabilities, data flows and dependencies, ensuring solutions are scalable, achievable and aligned to customer needs.Shape functional and non-functional data requirements, identifying critical business entities, attributes, metrics and data products required to support customer journeys, reporting, analytics and AI capabilities.Embed effective data stewardship practices, ensuring data ownership, definitions, quality standards, lineage, controls and regulatory obligations are understood, governed and consistently applied across journeys and products.Partner with Platform Leads, Data Product Owners, Engineers, Architects and AI specialists to ensure business needs and data requirements are translated into scalable, compliant and technology-enabled solutions.Use customer, operational and data insights to identify improvement opportunities, risks and actions, driving prioritisation decisions and continuous enhancement of Data, Analytics and AI capabilities.Orchestrate cross-functional delivery across business, operations, technology, risk and data teams, ensuring strategic Data & AI initiatives are aligned, dependencies are managed and intended customer and business outcomes are realised. What You'll NeedYou'll be able to demonstrate experience across the following areas: Customer Journey, Data & AI TransformationSignificant experience leading complex, end-to-end client or colleague journey transformation, using Data, Analytics and AI to deliver measurable improvements in customer outcomes, operational performance and business value.Proven ability to translate customer, business and regulatory needs into prioritised use cases and technology-enabled solutions, influencing product strategy, roadmaps and investment decisions. Data Stewardship & Data ProductsStrong data stewardship expertise, including the definition and application of data ownership, business terminology, critical data elements, quality standards, lineage, controls and regulatory obligations.Experience connecting journey and business requirements to authoritative data sources and strategic data products, ensuring data is trusted, reusable and fit for operational, analytical and AI-enabled use. Analysis, Insight & PrioritisationStrong strategic and analytical judgement, integrating customer insight, operational performance and data evidence to identify root causes, assess opportunities and shape outcome-led priorities.Ability to evaluate the feasibility, value and end-to-end impact of Data & AI propositions, balancing customer benefit, commercial value, control requirements and delivery viability. Product & Technology CollaborationExtensive experience working with Product Owners and multidisciplinary teams to shape propositions, influence backlogs and ensure journey, process, data and technology decisions deliver the intended outcomes.Strong understanding of business processes, system capabilities, data flows and integration points, translating complexity into clear requirements, design choices and delivery implications. rows.title: Model Risk Oversight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or an exciting new direction, we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We’re one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with a network that covers more than 50 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Model Risk Oversight Analyst.

Join our Model Risk Oversight Team within Retail Credit Risk Analytics in UK Wealth and Personal Banking (WPB) Risk. This role focuses on model risk management for models used in lending decisions and Basel regulatory reporting. You’ll help ensure robust governance, issue and control management and regulatory compliance aligned to SS1/23 and Global Model Risk Policy v5.1. Working closely with stakeholders across the first and second line - including Model Risk Management (MRM), Group Retail Credit Risk (GRCR), model owners/sponsors and portfolio teams - you’ll keep oversight activities running smoothly and to policy standards. Success means clear, timely governance outcomes, accurate inventories, well-managed actions from validations and reporting that gives senior stakeholders confidence in model risk compliance.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you’ll have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role You Will

 Facilitate key model governance forums by producing packs, minutes and approvals and taking changes through the correct route to PRA submission where required  Monitor model risk metrics and compliance then explain results and escalate breaches where needed  Manage first line post model validation activity by tracking action plans, progressing outcomes and drafting accurate Model Sponsor summaries  Maintain a high-quality model inventory by keeping GMIS accurate and complete  Own issue and control management by monitoring RCR Analytics MSIIs and controls and raising new MSIIs to policy standards  Create dashboards and monthly RMF reporting to provide clear updates for senior stakeholders  Deliver regulatory and policy change by adapting oversight processes to SS1/23 and Global Model Risk Policy updates including tiering, conditional approvals and industry models  Simplify and automate oversight processes through documentation, removal of duplication and improvements that strengthen team continuity 

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

 Bring retail product knowledge across Credit Cards, Mortgages, Loans and Overdrafts  Apply experience from credit risk, analytics, modelling, model management or model governance environments  Demonstrate strong organisational skills across multiple governance deliverables to fixed timelines including packs, minutes, approvals, attestations and dashboards  Communicate clearly in writing and verbally with the ability to tailor messages for technical and senior audiences and escalate issues with clarity  Use Microsoft Office and Co-Pilot effectively and bring exposure to governance tooling such as GMIS or Helios where possible  Partner effectively across teams including MRM and GRCR to support consistent, right-first-time governance outcomes  Apply understanding of model risk governance concepts such as model changes, monitoring, inventories, issues, controls and approvals  Work with regulatory expectations and policy-driven delivery including SS1/23 and model risk policy frameworks 

 Opening up a world of opportunity. 

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. Our recruitment processes are accessible to everyone - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

Role

rows.title: Senior Decision Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as a Senior Decision Intelligence Analyst, where you'll help solve complex business challenges and improve customer and business outcomes through insight-led decision making. You will develop decision products, generate actionable insights, and provide clear recommendations that support strategic and operational decisions across the business.

Success in this role requires more than technical analytics capability. We are looking for individuals who can frame complex business problems, identify the most important insights, evaluate alternative solutions and make clear recommendations supported by evidence. Candidates should be comfortable working with ambiguity, applying structured thinking and exercising sound commercial judgement.

To be successful as a Senior Decision Intelligence Analyst, you should have:


Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to structure ambiguous business challengesProven experience in analytics, decision science, strategy, consulting or research rolesDeep commercial awareness and experience balancing customer, business and operational outcomesAbility to translate complex business problems into clear analytical approaches and recommendationsExperience identifying key drivers of business performance and turning data into actionable insightEffective stakeholder management and communication skillsExperience using evidence and insight to influence decision making and challenge existing assumptionsAbility to present complex findings and recommendations to non-technical audiencesCollaborative approach to working with cross-functional teamsExperience leading analytical activities end-to-end, from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through to implementation, benefit realisation and impact measurement


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Experience at a large Consulting firm (preferably Analytics, Strategy or Customer Consulting)Experience in financial services or other customer-focused industriesDemonstrated experience solving customer, commercial or strategic business problemsDegree in a quantitative or business-related field (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Computer Science, etc.)Knowledge of customer analytics, proposition development or decisioning methodologiesUnderstanding of experimentation, measurement and evidence-based decision makingExperience mentoring junior team membersExperience working within Agile delivery environments and adapting analytical approaches to evolving business prioritiesKnowledge of programming languages commonly used in analytics (Python, R, SQL)Experience working with cloud-based analytics platforms and modern data ecosystems (e.g. Databricks)Knowledge of machine learning and AI applications


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role can be based in either London, Northampton or Glasgow.

Purpose of the role

To provide independent and balanced advice and counsel to senior stakeholders through problem identification, solving and decision making practices.

Accountabilities


Provision of strategic advice to Group Executives to support the decision-making process of business challenges and opportunities.Development and implementation of strategic advisory incentives to grow and optimise the bank’s operations, through market research and analysis.Collaboration with various stakeholder groups to identify the appropriate strategic direction type to meet the needs of Barclays clients and investors.Development of financial models to support strategic recommendations and transactions through financial data analysis, financial projects and considering the financial impact of transactions.Management of transactions, negotiations, transaction structure development and post-transaction integration.Collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain client relationships, and develop new relationships to identify opportunities.Identification of industry trends, maintain peer benchmarking and developments related to strategic advisory services by attendings conferences, participating in training and conducting market research.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomesIf the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Data Programme Director
rows.descriptionText:
Ready to lead a strategic data transformation across regulated risk and finance reporting? 

 Why HSBC 

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

 The Role 

Default and Forbearance data underpins retail credit models, capital measures and financial reporting across Risk and Finance, and is subject to increasing scrutiny of data quality, controls and evidence of compliance. It is currently supported by a tactical, manual and labour-intensive solution that creates operational risk and limits long-term sustainability.

This role sits within the Chief Data and Analytics Office team, supporting International Wealth and Premier Banking, and partners closely with Risk, Finance and Technology. You’ll be accountable for the end-to-end programme to deliver a strategic, controlled and scalable data solution, bringing multiple workstreams into a single governed plan spanning process, data, technology, controls, policy alignment and migration cutover. Success will mean stronger controls, improved data quality, fewer manual interventions and clear, audit-ready evidence of decisions and delivery outcomes.

What You'll Be Doing

 Lead the end-to-end delivery of the strategic Default and Forbearance Data programme across process, data, technology, controls, policy alignment and migration cutover Establish and own an integrated delivery plan with clear milestones, critical-path dependencies and cross-functional commitments Steer delivery across global and regional stakeholders, aligning outcomes with regulatory and reporting timelines and ensuring measurable evidence of progress Establish robust programme governance with clear decision rights, escalation routes and disciplined tracking of actions and outcomes Provide executive-level reporting, including dashboards, milestone and dependency tracking, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, and change control Embed rigorous delivery controls, including documentation standards, evidence retention, testing, sign-off and cutover readiness Oversee budgets, forecasts and resource planning across internal teams and suppliers, where applicable Ensure the target-state solution is operationalised, fully documented and successfully transitioned into ongoing support after go-live

What We're Looking For

 Proven leadership and delivery of complex, multi-workstream programmes spanning data, process and technology change in regulated environments A strong track record of establishing programme governance and delivering decision-ready executive reporting across milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions and change control Substantial experience of migrating tactical, manual processes to strategic, scalable solutions supported by a clear operating model and robust controls Strong risk and control discipline across delivery, including audit-ready documentation, evidence management, testing, sign-off and cutover controls The credibility and influence to align senior stakeholders across Risk, Finance and Technology, secure prioritisation and sustain executive sponsorship The ability to translate complex delivery detail into clear choices, impacts and decision points for executive forums Demonstrated oversight of budgets, forecasts and resource capacity, underpinned by clear financial governance A strong record of building and developing high-performing teams across direct and matrixed workstreams, with clear objectives, accountability and consistent delivery standards

 Building a sustainable data solution 

This is a high-impact executive opportunity to shape and deliver a strategic data solution supporting critical models and financial reporting. You’ll partner across functions to improve data quality, strengthen governance and reduce the operational risk created by manual processes. The programme requires decisive leadership, rigorous delivery discipline, strong control standards and reporting that enables timely executive decisions and stands up to scrutiny. If you have the ambition and experience to establish a sustainable target state that supports regulatory compliance across retail portfolios, we’d like to hear from you.

rows.descriptionText:
Senior Software Engineer  

About The Role

We are seeking talented Senior Software Engineers to join our Search Engineering team and help build the next generation of AI-powered search experiences.

In this role, you will design and build large-scale backend and model-serving infrastructure that powers search retrieval, ranking, personalization, and emerging LLM-based search experiences. You will work on systems that operate at high request volumes with strict latency and reliability requirements, spanning traditional search infrastructure, machine learning model serving, and modern LLM inference.

You will collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers, data scientists, product managers, and platform teams to evolve the search stack toward more intelligent, real-time, and AI-native architectures. This includes integrating LLM-based ranking and retrieval, optimizing GPU inference and serving efficiency, incorporating real-time marketplace signals, and building scalable infrastructure that enables rapid experimentation while maintaining production-grade performance and reliability.

Basic Qualifications

 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building large-scale backend or distributed systems.  Strong programming skills in Go, Java, C++, Python, or a similar language.  Strong understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented architectures, concurrency, networking, caching, and data consistency.  Experience building high-throughput, low-latency online serving systems.  Experience with search, recommendation, ranking, machine learning serving, or other large-scale data-intensive systems.  Experience diagnosing and optimizing system performance across latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.  Familiarity with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, or similar frameworks.  Experience operating production systems, including observability, monitoring, capacity planning, incident response, and reliability engineering.  Strong system design, problem-solving, and analytical skills with the ability to work across multiple layers of a complex production stack. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience building search and recommendation systems, including retrieval, ranking, query understanding, indexing, and personalization.  Hands-on experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Vespa, Lucene, or large-scale proprietary search systems.  Experience with LLM or ML model-serving infrastructure, including frameworks such as vLLM, Triton, or similar inference platforms.  Experience optimizing GPU-based inference workloads, including batching or micro-batching, request scheduling, model parallelism, memory management, and GPU utilization.  Familiarity with LLM serving concepts such as prefill/decode, KV caching, prefix caching, streaming generation, speculative techniques, and distributed inference.  Experience with embeddings, semantic retrieval, approximate nearest-neighbor search, semantic IDs, or generative retrieval.  Familiarity with constrained decoding or integrating real-time business and marketplace constraints into AI-powered serving systems.  Experience integrating near-real-time features and signals into latency-sensitive ranking or inference systems.  Experience designing ML/LLM systems with strong reliability, graceful degradation, experimentation, and launch-safety mechanisms. 

 What the Candidate Will Do 

 Design and build highly scalable search and AI serving infrastructure with a focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.  Develop the backend architecture for next-generation AI-powered search, including LLM-based retrieval, ranking, personalization, and generative search experiences.  Integrate large language models and machine learning models into production search serving paths while meeting stringent latency and reliability requirements.  Optimize GPU inference and model-serving performance through techniques such as batching, micro-batching, request routing, caching, streaming, and efficient resource utilization.  Build infrastructure for advanced LLM-serving patterns such as context prefill, KV/prefix-cache reuse, progressive or streaming generation, and efficient multi-turn or paginated search experiences.  Develop scalable retrieval and ranking systems spanning lexical retrieval, semantic retrieval, embeddings, structured signals, and ML/LLM-based ranking.  Work on semantic-ID and constrained-decoding infrastructure that allows generative models to interact safely and efficiently with large-scale search catalogs and real-time marketplace signals.  Build and optimize real-time feature retrieval, hydration, caching, and data-processing systems that provide fresh signals to ranking and LLM models.  Partner closely with ML engineers and data scientists to productionize new ranking and relevance models, improve experimentation velocity, and shorten the path from model development to production.  Continuously improve end-to-end search performance by identifying bottlenecks across retrieval, feature serving, model inference, orchestration, networking, and presentation hydration.  Design systems for graceful degradation, observability, capacity management, experimentation, and safe production rollouts of new AI and search capabilities.  Analyze production and experiment metrics to understand latency, relevance, reliability, and business trade-offs and use those insights to guide system architecture.  Contribute to the long-term technical architecture of the Search platform as it evolves from traditional multi-stage retrieval and ranking toward increasingly unified, AI-native search systems.  Write high-quality, maintainable production code and provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration.  Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed search and AI-serving systems and drive improvements that prevent recurrence.

Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle.  Prepare and deliver strategic recommendations, program insights, and performance updates to senior leadership.  Own the U.S. immigration budget, including forecasting, financial planning, vendor spend management, and budget-to-actual reviews.  Build and maintain strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, and business leaders, influencing decisions and positioning immigration as a strategic enabler of Uber's talent objectives. rows.title: Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Our purpose – Opening up a world of opportunity – explains why we exist. Here at HSBC, we use our unique expertise, capabilities, breadth, and perspectives to open up new kinds of opportunity for our more than 40 million customers. We’re bringing together the people, ideas and capital that nurture progress and growth, helping to create a better world – for our customers, our people, our investors, our communities, and the planet we all share

In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in the US. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.

As Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit, you will lead audit coverage of ERM and Governance in the US. The ERM and Governance Audit team is responsible for audit coverage of the management of the ERM function and Corporate Governance across HSBC Group, including the management of operational and resilience risks. This is achieved through both direct audit coverage and providing subject-matter expertise to monitor and direct the audit coverage across Global Internal Audit.

As Senior Audit Manager - Enterprise-wide Risk Management (ERM) and Governance Audit, you will:

 Lead a team of 3 audit managers, overseeing delivery of all US audits in the ERM and Governance Audit Plan  Interact with local regulators regarding GIA coverage of relevant activities, notably 2LOD oversight of operational and resilience risks  Manage the relationship with relevant stakeholders in the US on major plans, projects, strategic developments, and industry trends, both to understand and provide input to emerging risks and issues and assess the impact on the planned schedule of audits  Co-ordinate GIA coverage of applicable regulatory requirements, such as Heightened Standards, across multiple audit teams in the US  Effectively manage some individual audits and activity through planning and delivery of the annual audit plan within expected timeframe, standards, methodology, budget, and best practices  Confirm that audit findings and recommendations are understood and appropriately addressed  Demonstrate knowledge of the applicable business and regulatory environment impacting ERM and Governance, including developing trends, risks, controls, and expectations  Support a strong risk and conduct culture across the Group and promote awareness and sound operational and strategic decision-making  Critically analyses and determine key drivers of change for area of coverage and assess how these will impact GIA’s engagements  Identify audit process improvements to increase productivity and efficiency without impacting effectiveness

Qualifications And Experience

You’ll likely have the following qualifications to succeed in this role:

 Extensive relevant work experience in the Financial Services Sector, with prior experience in internal audit, consultancy, or external audit preferred, but not essential  Experience of team management  Knowledge of the applicable regulatory requirements in the US and business processes related to ERM and Governance  Relevant accounting, audit, analytical, financial, project management, quantitative, risk, and technology skills, qualifications or certifications  Undergraduate or graduate degree in business, accounting, mathematics, or social sciences. Preference given to qualified accountants, CIA, CISA, CFE, or ACAMS  Fluency in English  Willingness to travel  Experience in defining and utilizing data-driven techniques including data analytics, process mining & AI is desirable but not essential  Analytical and critical thinker, who can effectively manage competing priorities and complex challenges to deliver positive outcomes and apply technology or expertise to business issues or operational problems 

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!

The final fixed pay offer will depend on the candidate and a number of variables, including but not limited to, role responsibilities, skill set, depth of experience and education, licensing/certification requirements, internal relativity, and specific work location.

rows.descriptionText:
Uber AI Solutions (UAIS) is a startup inside Uber, building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind the next generation of AI. The models making headlines are only as good as the data and feedback they learn from, and that is the work we do.

We are an agile team moving at startup speed with the full weight of Uber behind us: global reach, world class infrastructure, and one of the largest human networks in the world. We pair that network with machine learning to produce the high quality, model ready data that the most advanced AI teams on earth depend on. Our work spans every modality, from text, images, and video to audio and physical AI and AVs, and reaches across dozens of countries.

This is a place for builders who want real ownership. Here you own a problem, not a ticket: you take a vertical from start to finish, the machine learning, the backend systems, and the product, and drive it from a blank page to something the best customers in AI rely on every day. You work shoulder to shoulder with product managers and other exceptional engineers, go as deep as the problem demands, and make the calls that decide whether your area wins. It is the closest thing to running your own company, with a rocket strapped to it.

If you want your work to show up in the AI systems shaping the world, and you want to build it like a founder, this is the team.

What You'll Do

 Build the ML and backend systems that turn your vision into a product customers pay for and rely on, going as deep as the problem requires.  Own your vertical end to end: find the opportunities, set the direction, and drive the business metrics that matter, such as revenue, adoption, and customer value.  Move fast in ambiguity: prioritize ruthlessly, make the calls, and turn ideas into shipped, revenue generating products with a product manager and a small senior team.  Be a trusted technical partner in the customer relationship where relevant, using what you learn to grow the account.  Raise the bar on execution and quality so your business can scale. 

Basic Qualifications

 Bachelor's or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.  5+ years of professional experience designing, building, and operating production ML systems, including strong backend engineering across the full path from data to serving.  Track record of driving business impact, not just shipping features: you have owned a product or product line and helped move metrics such as revenue, adoption, or customer value.  Fluency in Python for machine learning and a production systems language such as Go, Java, or C++, and the ability to build reliable services and run them in production.  Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving fast: you find the highest value problems yourself, make the call, and drive them without waiting to be told.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align customers, product, and engineering around what will grow the business. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.  You have grown a product or business line in a startup or startup like environment, owning outcomes end to end and treating revenue and customer growth as your job.  Experience applying machine learning to a real world data or evaluation domain, such as physical world data collection, RL environments and agentic evaluation, multilingual or audio data, or data quality and verification, where success was measured by business impact rather than model metrics alone.  Direct experience with GenAI and LLM systems in production, including evaluation harnesses, model tuning, forced alignment or ASR, or pipelines that keep a model in the loop.  Depth in one or more UAIS domains: real world and physical world data such as POI and embodied capture, agentic RL environments, multilingual and multimodal ML, video and LiDAR annotation, or physical AI and robotics data.

rows.descriptionText:
Senior Software Engineer  

About The Role

We are seeking talented Senior Software Engineers to join our Search Engineering team and help build the next generation of AI-powered search experiences.

In this role, you will design and build large-scale backend and model-serving infrastructure that powers search retrieval, ranking, personalization, and emerging LLM-based search experiences. You will work on systems that operate at high request volumes with strict latency and reliability requirements, spanning traditional search infrastructure, machine learning model serving, and modern LLM inference.

You will collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers, data scientists, product managers, and platform teams to evolve the search stack toward more intelligent, real-time, and AI-native architectures. This includes integrating LLM-based ranking and retrieval, optimizing GPU inference and serving efficiency, incorporating real-time marketplace signals, and building scalable infrastructure that enables rapid experimentation while maintaining production-grade performance and reliability.

Basic Qualifications

 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building large-scale backend or distributed systems.  Strong programming skills in Go, Java, C++, Python, or a similar language.  Strong understanding of distributed systems, service-oriented architectures, concurrency, networking, caching, and data consistency.  Experience building high-throughput, low-latency online serving systems.  Experience with search, recommendation, ranking, machine learning serving, or other large-scale data-intensive systems.  Experience diagnosing and optimizing system performance across latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.  Familiarity with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Spark, or similar frameworks.  Experience operating production systems, including observability, monitoring, capacity planning, incident response, and reliability engineering.  Strong system design, problem-solving, and analytical skills with the ability to work across multiple layers of a complex production stack. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience building search and recommendation systems, including retrieval, ranking, query understanding, indexing, and personalization.  Hands-on experience with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr, Vespa, Lucene, or large-scale proprietary search systems.  Experience with LLM or ML model-serving infrastructure, including frameworks such as vLLM, Triton, or similar inference platforms.  Experience optimizing GPU-based inference workloads, including batching or micro-batching, request scheduling, model parallelism, memory management, and GPU utilization.  Familiarity with LLM serving concepts such as prefill/decode, KV caching, prefix caching, streaming generation, speculative techniques, and distributed inference.  Experience with embeddings, semantic retrieval, approximate nearest-neighbor search, semantic IDs, or generative retrieval.  Familiarity with constrained decoding or integrating real-time business and marketplace constraints into AI-powered serving systems.  Experience integrating near-real-time features and signals into latency-sensitive ranking or inference systems.  Experience designing ML/LLM systems with strong reliability, graceful degradation, experimentation, and launch-safety mechanisms. 

 What the Candidate Will Do 

 Design and build highly scalable search and AI serving infrastructure with a focus on latency, throughput, reliability, and infrastructure efficiency.  Develop the backend architecture for next-generation AI-powered search, including LLM-based retrieval, ranking, personalization, and generative search experiences.  Integrate large language models and machine learning models into production search serving paths while meeting stringent latency and reliability requirements.  Optimize GPU inference and model-serving performance through techniques such as batching, micro-batching, request routing, caching, streaming, and efficient resource utilization.  Build infrastructure for advanced LLM-serving patterns such as context prefill, KV/prefix-cache reuse, progressive or streaming generation, and efficient multi-turn or paginated search experiences.  Develop scalable retrieval and ranking systems spanning lexical retrieval, semantic retrieval, embeddings, structured signals, and ML/LLM-based ranking.  Work on semantic-ID and constrained-decoding infrastructure that allows generative models to interact safely and efficiently with large-scale search catalogs and real-time marketplace signals.  Build and optimize real-time feature retrieval, hydration, caching, and data-processing systems that provide fresh signals to ranking and LLM models.  Partner closely with ML engineers and data scientists to productionize new ranking and relevance models, improve experimentation velocity, and shorten the path from model development to production.  Continuously improve end-to-end search performance by identifying bottlenecks across retrieval, feature serving, model inference, orchestration, networking, and presentation hydration.  Design systems for graceful degradation, observability, capacity management, experimentation, and safe production rollouts of new AI and search capabilities.  Analyze production and experiment metrics to understand latency, relevance, reliability, and business trade-offs and use those insights to guide system architecture.  Contribute to the long-term technical architecture of the Search platform as it evolves from traditional multi-stage retrieval and ranking toward increasingly unified, AI-native search systems.  Write high-quality, maintainable production code and provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and cross-team collaboration.  Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed search and AI-serving systems and drive improvements that prevent recurrence.

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Do you want to Be A Part of something unique?

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Sales Manager - Connections Rainmaker at Hart Shoreditch London Hotel, Curio Collection , you’re not just generating and managing sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Food and beverage discounts – Receive 50% off food and beverage at participating outlets.  Employee Meal Allowance – Helping you stay energised throughout your shift.  Generous holiday allowance – Enjoy 28 days' holiday including bank holidays, increasing with service.  Pension scheme – Supporting you as you plan for the future.  High street discounts – Access a range of exclusive savings through Perks at Work.  Mental health resources – Through our Care for All hub, Team Members have access to wellbeing resources, alongside free counselling and support through our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).  Crisis Concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for practical support and emotional care.  Career development opportunities – Grow with Hilton through learning and development programmes designed to support your personal and professional growth  Recommend a Friend Scheme Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan. 

Hart Shoreditch Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton is a boutique lifestyle hotel based in the cultural, creative and trendy scene of Shoreditch and we are currently on the hunt for a dynamic and charismati Connections Rainmaker

Our team strives to be friendly, supportive and inclusive and we are always looking for people who live and breathe these values.

Hilton’s Curio Collection brand appeals to travelers seeking one-of-a-kind discoveries and authentic experiences. Each Curio Collection by Hilton hotel is part of the destination it calls home — authentically embodying the distinct culture and spirit of the community in which they reside.

Responsibilities

HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO DURING A TYPICAL DAY:

The Sales Manager - Connections Rainmaker is the driving force behind new commercial opportunities at Hart Shoreditch, a natural networker who opens doors, builds strong relationships and turns connections into revenue. The role is focused on creating business across Rooms, Events, F&B and Marketing, from the local market through to international opportunities.

Working closely with the Commercial Director and wider commercial team, the Connections Rainmaker will be out in the market creating conversations, spotting opportunities, making things happen, and converting relationships into new, repeat and incremental business while growing revenue, market share and the hotel’s profile.

Core Focus And Responsibilities

 Drive revenue opportunities across Groups & Events, Restaurant & Bar, Business Travel, Consortia and other key market segments Proactively generate new business through sales calls, networking, client meetings, trade shows, business trips, sales missions and industry events both domestically and internationally Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers, partners, agencies and local businesses to maximise commercial opportunities Maximise sales leads, conversion, repeat and future business on all relevant segments Organise and host show rounds, client entertainment and fam trips to support prospecting, conversion and account development Work closely with Marketing & Partnerships team to develop local collaborations, partnerships and initiatives that generate incremental revenue and strengthen the hotel’s brand Monitor and report on market trends, competitor activity, customer behaviour, demand patterns and emerging business opportunities to identify new sales opportunities Provide regular reporting and business intelligence on sales activity, pipeline, leads, conversion, account performance, market trends, competitor movements and ROI across sales activities Prepare monthly business reviews and maintain accurate sales reporting

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR?

Skills

 Self-driven and entrepreneurial generating new business, building networks and converting relationships into revenue Proactive networker building strong relationships with different groups of people Excellent sales, negotiation and influencing skills Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify revenue opportunities and maximise conversion Strong analytical skills with sales data and market intelligence, turning insights into clear sales actions Highly organised with strong pipeline, account and activity management skills Confident presenter and brand ambassador representing the business to clients, partners and industry contacts, including sales pitches, show rounds and client events onsite/offsite Flexible and adaptable, able to respond positively to changing business needs and a variety of work situations Willing and able to travel, attend industry events and undertake client entertainment as required Self-motivated, accountable and resilient

Knowledge & Experience

 Knowledge of hotel sales, revenue generation and business development, ideally across Groups & Events, Food & Drink, Business Travel Good understanding of local, domestic and international markets, customer segments and competitive landscape Understanding of sales pipelines, conversion, account management, market trends and commercial performance Knowledge of relevant sales, marketing and networking channels such as event agencies, corporate contacts, travel/industry partners Previous experiences in hotel sales, restaurant, venue sales, booking office

BEHAVIOURS

 Natural rainmaker: proactive, well connected and constantly looking for opportunities to generate business Commercially driven: motivated by results, revenue growth and achieving targets Relationship focused: confident and comfortable building trusted relationships with people from diverse backgrounds, industries and cultures Entrepreneurial and curious: identifies opportunities, challenges the status quo and looks for new and innovative ways of working Highly organised and accountable: takes ownership, follows through on commitments and maintains strong attention to detail Adaptable and resilient: embraces change, remains positive under pressure and brings energy and enthusiasm to the role

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE?

Success at Hart Shoreditch means becoming a true commercial rainmaker for the hotel — building strong connections, generating new and repeat business, and turning relationships and market opportunities into measurable revenue from both local and international markets.

You will have a visible presence in the marketplace, a strong sales pipeline, clear commercial insight and a proactive approach that helps grow revenue, increase market share and strengthen Hart Shoreditch’s brand position in the market.

Ultimately, Hart Shoreditch becomes the destination where people naturally choose to gather, stay and celebrate.

Work hours  will be based on business needs, including evenings and weekends as required.

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Want to help shape the future of retail? Are you looking for a highly visible role helping to define and scale Live commerce at eBay?

Fast-paced, dynamic, and proactive, eBay Live’s Trust & Safety teams are dedicated to creating the world’s most secure and trusted live shopping experience. Working at the intersection of innovation, risk management, and customer trust, our teams help enable the safe, sustainable, and scalable growth of the eBay Live ecosystem while protecting buyers, sellers, and creators across the platform.

As a Senior Manager of Data Science and Analytics, you will lead a team of data analysts partnering directly with the eBay Live business unit (specifically their interactions with the Trust, Risk, and Compliance organizations) to identify opportunities, assess business impact, and translate insights into operational and strategic decisions. You will leverage advanced analytics and predictive modeling to guide marketplace decisions, helping the organization proactively manage risk while supporting growth objectives. rows.descriptionText:
Be part of an amazing story

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. We’ve been part of memorable moments and milestones for countless customers and colleagues. Those stories are part of what makes this such a special place to work.

Job Overview

The Site Merchandising Associate supports site operations, testing, and merchandising functions. They enhance the success of Macys.com by partnering with business and support teams to ensure flawless site execution and the launch of new features and system enhancements. The Site Merchandiser devises and recommends digital strategies to maximize the online assortment and drive site traffic.

What You Will Do

Ensure data consistency across all customer touchpoints and devices. Establish best practices based on competitive landscape and assist in promotion execution, brand shop execution, and facet and browse optimization.Optimize product detail pages, including size and fit information, attribution, tagging, page layout, images, reviews, and CGC.Manage taxonomy optimization, including header fly-outs and left-hand navigation. Collaborate with SEO and UX teams to develop best practices.Optimize on-site search by addressing failed search terms and acting on trending phrases and key brands.Enhance event execution by optimizing promo codes, PWPs, GWPs, sequencing, and boosting.Drive affiliate and SEM performance through weekly submissions of top-performing offers.Identify online opportunities to increase sales, conversion, and profit performance.Collaborate with merchant teams to understand business strategy, objectives, and priorities.Prepare and present quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to optimize taxonomy and search strategies, including competitive deep dives. Provide insights and strategies for the best online experience.Foster strategic cross-functional relationships with merchants, marketing, creative production, production, and internal site merchandise partners to leverage resources and establish best-in-class event execution.Seek opportunities to grow the business by improving the customer shopping experience through innovation and competitive analysis.Work with business intelligence, experimentation, and relevancy teams to understand and develop comprehensive strategies for site audits.Assist with training and developing assistants and trainees on the team. Share best practices across site merchandising to support overall team growth.Foster an environment of acceptance and respect that strengthens relationships, and ensures authentic connections with colleagues, customers, and communitiesIn addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Collaboration: Collaborate with merchant teams to understand business strategy, objectives, and priorities.

Presentation Skills: Prepare and present quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to optimize taxonomy and search strategies, including competitive deep dives. Provide insights and strategies for the best online experience.

Technical Communication: Effectively share technical information, communicate technical issues, and solutions to all levels of the business.

Cross-Functional Relationship Building: Foster strategic relationships with merchants, marketing, creative production, production, and internal site merchandise partners to leverage resources and establish best-in-class event execution.

Innovation and Competitive Analysis: Seek opportunities to grow the business by improving the customer shopping experience through innovation and competitive analysis.

Data Analysis: Work with business intelligence, experimentation, and relevancy teams to understand and develop comprehensive strategies for site audits.

Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple projects, identify primary and secondary objectives, prioritize time, and communicate timelines to team members.

Product/Project Ownership: Ability and desire to take ownership of products and projects.

Creative and Strategic Thinking: Ability to think creatively, strategically, and technically.

Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of MS Office computer programs is required.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3-5 years of direct experience. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Some Additional Benefits We Offer Include

Merchandise discounts Performance-based incentives Annual merit review Employee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial advice Tuition reimbursement 

 Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

Join us and help write the next chapter in our story - apply today!

This job description is not all-inclusive. Macy's, Inc. reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Macy's, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

rows.title: Senior Architect, Corporate Systems
rows.descriptionText:
Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500+ employees and ~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Corporate Systems is Cvent’s internal business application platform, responsible for designing, building, and operating the systems that power how revenue is captured, cash moves, people are supported, and data flows across the company. Our core corporate system platforms include Salesforce (Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud), Oracle EBS, Snowflake, Informatica, Sigma, UiPath, Coupa, Concur, Certinia, and Intellievent, along with adjacencies such as HighRadius, Kyriba, Safebooks.AI, Marketo, 6sense, Gainsight, Staircase, Chorus, Gong, Nice InContact, and ZoomInfo. We operate nine sub-functions and run simultaneous transformation programs — and as a serial acquirer, maintain a consistent, scalable playbook for Post-Merger System Integration (PMI) — each with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, and financial integrity.

We are hiring a Corporate Systems Architect to provide the architectural leadership this complexity demands — setting the standards, patterns, and technical direction that enable our teams and partners to design, build, and scale with consistency and confidence across our application estate, data landscape, and AI capabilities.

Define and steward enterprise architecture

Own the target-state architecture across our core corporate system platforms — Salesforce (Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud), Oracle EBS, Snowflake, Informatica, Sigma, UiPath, Coupa, Concur, Certinia, and Intellievent, along with adjacencies such as HighRadius, Kyriba, Safebooks.AI, Marketo, 6sense, Gainsight, Staircase, Chorus, Gong, Nice InContact, and ZoomInfo — ensuring a coherent, well-governed, and future-ready platform estate.Establish Cvent’s architectural paved road — reusable reference patterns across experience, integration, data, AI, and security that empower delivery teams and partners to design and scale with confidence. Define data contracts, cross-system impact assessment, and how quality and resilience are built in as enduring principles.

Lead AI architecture and the agentic framework

Own the AI orchestration and agentic framework — connecting Agentforce agents, Snowflake Cortex models, semantic layers, and business rules into a governed, production-ready ecosystem across the enterprise application estate.Architect AI-enabled solutions across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle — including Agentforce Account Summary and Next Best Action, conversational analytics agents, PS intelligent automation, and AI-driven financial governance — with data privacy and responsible AI governance embedded from the outset in partnership with the AI Governance Council and the broader IT organization including InfoSec.

Shape Lead-to-Cash architecture across PLG, SLG, and M&A

Own the end-to-end Lead-to-Cash architecture — how leads are qualified and progressed, commercial terms configured, and orders, subscriptions, overages, and revenue flows modelled and governed across Salesforce CPQ, Oracle EBS, Stripe/Chargebee, Snowflake, and Gainsight — underpinning revenue integrity and financial reporting.Architect PLG and SLG convergence for acquired organizations as we execute PMI — delivering repeatable, documented approaches that accelerate time-to-value with each acquisition.

Own data and integration architecture with Data Governance

Define master data architecture for Accounts, Contacts, Subscriptions, Contracts, Products, and Financials — establishing systems of record and data contracts across Salesforce, EBS, CVII, Marketo, and Snowflake. Partner closely with the Data Governance function to embed quality, stewardship, and lineage into platform design from the outset.Set integration design standards governing pipeline architecture, schema change management, resilience patterns, and entitlement management. Collaborate with Analytics and CloudOps to advance Snowflake as the enterprise intelligence platform for analytics, BI, and AI workloads.

Lead governance, provide the architecture framework, and build the community

Serve as architecture owner for transformation programs across Corporate Systems and Cvent, the overall AI portfolio, and M&A — providing the architecture framework of standards, patterns, review processes, and decision criteria that enables architects across CRM, Oracle, Snowflake, and integration domains to operate with autonomy and scale their work.Drive design review (ARB) across teams and external partners. Act as trusted advisor to VP IT, CIO, and business leaders. Work closely with architects already embedded across CRM, Oracle, and Snowflake environments — co-owning direction, raising collective standards, and contributing to talent strategy as the architecture community grows.15-20+ years in enterprise or corporate systems architecture, owning large-scale CRM, ERP, and data platform transformations in complex, global B2B environments.Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise: Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud — Apex, integration patterns, security model, org design, and Agentforce configuration and governance.Solid Oracle EBS knowledge: GL, AR/AP, billing and revenue flows, and the patterns connecting Salesforce commercial data to EBS invoicing, revenue recognition, and financial controls.Meaningful Snowflake architecture experience — schema design, semantic and data contract layers, Cortex and AI capabilities, and how DWH design choices shape analytics and AI workloads.Integration and MDM depth with Informatica or comparable platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Tray) and a strong understanding of resilient, observable pipeline architecture across complex application landscapes.Practical experience designing agentic architectures — LLM grounding and retrieval, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop design, and governance frameworks that scale across an enterprise.The ability to build architecture frameworks that enable distributed teams to make consistent, high-quality design decisions — and to communicate trade-offs clearly to Finance, CS, and RevOps leaders.Proven Senior Director track record owning cross-functional programs and influencing senior stakeholders. Salesforce Architect certifications strongly preferred. Snowflake, Oracle EBS, TOGAF a plus.

What Success Looks Like (12-24 Months)

A North Star architecture for Corporate Systems — spanning transformation programs, Lead-to-Cash, the AI portfolio, and M&A — actively used as the authoritative reference by delivery teams and partners.An architecture framework in place that enables architects across CRM, Oracle, Snowflake, and integration domains to make consistent, high-quality design decisions independently and at scale.A governed AI and agentic architecture with high-impact solutions in production across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, with clear data contracts, observable behavior, and measurable business outcomes.A Corporate Systems architecture community recognized for technical depth, shared design culture, and a consistently high standard of quality across all sub-functions and programs.

We are not able to offer sponsorship for this position

rows.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Our Opportunity

The Inbound Technology and Data Science team is an integral part of Chewy’s Operations Technology organization. Our team builds the products and science-based capabilities that maintain a healthy flow of inbound volume across Chewy’s 13 core fulfillment centers, ensuring our network has the right inventory and labor in place to serve pet parents.

We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chewy’s inbound planning products. This role will lead the evolution of our 13-week planning process from manually coordinated workflows toward scalable, automated, and science-based solutions.

This highly visible and cross-functional role will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Replenishment, Transportation, In Stock, and Fulfillment Center Operations teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that the ecosystem of inbound products and teams works together effectively to support near-term operational needs and Chewy’s long-term growth. The ideal candidate is a clear communicator and trusted partner who uses data to influence decisions, align senior leaders, and translate complex supply chain challenges into scalable technical solutions.

What You’ll Do

Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Chewy’s inbound planning capabilities, with a focus on automation, scalability, and science-based decision-making.Own the technical products supporting the 13-week inbound planning process across Chewy’s 13 core fulfillment centers.Identify opportunities to innovate and improve how inbound volume, labor, inventory, capacity, and operational constraints are planned across the fulfillment network.Partner with engineering and data science teams to translate complex business and operational needs into clear product requirements, technical capabilities, and use cases.Work alongside engineering and data science throughout the development lifecycle to scope, test, launch, and continuously improve inbound planning solutions.Coordinate across Replenishment, Transportation, In Stock, and Fulfillment Center Operations teams, including both business and technology partners, to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and ensure the broader product ecosystem works together effectively.Build trust with stakeholders by using data to frame problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive clear and objective decisions.Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners to establish shared priorities and alignment on inbound planning strategies.Define and track key performance indicators that measure planning quality, network health, operational efficiency, and product impact.Develop clear product documentation, including vision documents, roadmaps, business requirements, user stories, and leadership updates.Identify risks and dependencies early, establish mitigation plans, and communicate changes or tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders.Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends in supply chain planning, automation, optimization, and data science to inform product strategy and drive innovation.

What You’ll Need

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.5+ years of experience as a Technical Product Manager or in a comparable product role, owning and driving complex technical roadmaps from strategy through execution.Demonstrated experience translating complex business and operational challenges into scalable technical products and clear requirements.Proven ability to develop product vision documents, roadmaps, business requirements, user stories, epics, and use cases and to work effectively with agile development teams.Experience partnering closely with engineering and data science teams throughout product discovery, development, testing, launch, and iteration.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to generate insights, evaluate tradeoffs, and influence decisions.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts for senior leaders and diverse cross-functional audiences.Demonstrated ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.Experience managing dependencies across multiple products, systems, teams, and operational workflows.Passion for building products that improve operational efficiency, decision quality, scalability, and customer outcomes.

Bonus

Experience building or managing supply chain planning, inbound logistics, inventory, transportation, labor planning, or fulfillment technology products.Experience using SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI to analyze performance and support product decisions.Familiarity with data science and optimization techniques, including forecasting, simulation, machine learning, and scheduling or network optimization algorithms.Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud computing, and microservices architectures.Experience developing products that replace manual planning processes with automated, data-driven decision-making.

What You’ll Get

A place where you can be your authentic self and grow your career. Our pet parents and partners are from everywhere—different places and different walks of life. It is what makes them unique. Likewise, Chewtopians are encouraged to bring their perspectives to deliver on our mission!Work in a culture that cares, with managers who value you and your career journey. Be empowered to think big, thrive on delivering results, and become your best.Opportunities to develop meaningful connections with a diverse group of Chewtopians through Team Member Resource Groups and to celebrate inclusivity through company events, programs, and activities.Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, in addition to wellness programs and resources that enable you to be your best self in and outside of work.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of a Corporate Human Resources team at a top global hospitality company! As Senior Manager, Talent & Workforce Planning, Americas you will partner with our business leaders to attract, retain, and develop Hilton's most important asset, our Team Members. On the Talent & Leadership Development, Americas team, reporting to the Director, Talent & Leadership Development, Americas, you will drive talent strategy through talent review preparation, succession management, leadership pipelines, analytics, and enterprise talent programs across the Americas.

Develop and maintain talent review tools, talent profiles, dashboards, analytics, and executive-ready reporting in the Americas.Monitor and analyze talent, succession, mobility, and workforce data to identify trends, gaps, and areas of opportunity.Prepare materials, insights, and recommendations that support talent discussions, calibration activities, and leadership decision-making.Track talent health metrics and leadership pipeline readiness to inform development and succession actions.Support the administration and execution of GM, hotel leader, and functional talent review processes.Coordinate leadership development program activities and reporting in partnership with HR Operations leaders.
