rows.title: Senior Principal - Product Management & Program Leadership
rows.descriptionText:
Level: Senior Principal, Market Solutions
﻿**This role is not eligible for 100% remote work. Employees must live within a commutable distance of the Kansas City, Missouri metropolitan area and be willing to be onsite at the client and/or Slalom office up to 5 days a week. ** 
Who You'll Work With At Slalom, our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We are the connective tissue across all capabilities—bringing strategy to life through execution that is rigorous, adaptive, and outcome-driven. 
You’ll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about making things happen. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it’s a multi-workstream transformation or a product launch, we bring clarity, structure, and momentum to every engagement. 
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are—whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows.  What You’ll DoLead complex, high-impact client initiatives across industries, ensuring alignment with business goals and measurable outcomes.Define project scope, delivery approach, timelines, and success metrics, and manage engagements from inception through completion.Partner with cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data, and business stakeholders) to deliver innovative solutions.Oversee project execution, balancing delivery leadership with hands-on involvement, driving delivery plans, coordinating resources, mitigating risks, and ensuring utilization and profitability targets are met.Facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, and working sessions to shape direction and maintain alignment.Apply agile methodologies to accelerate delivery, foster collaboration, and adapt to evolving needs.Use AI-powered tools and techniques (e.g., predictive analytics for forecasting, automation for reporting, generative AI for documentation) to improve speed, quality, and decision-making.Support the sales lifecycle by scoping opportunities, developing delivery approaches, and contributing to proposals while selling delivery capabilities and outcomes.Mentor consultants and delivery leads, and contribute to the growth of Slalom’s delivery frameworks and practices.
What You’ll BringProven experience selling professional services, including shaping solutions, partnering with sales teams, and influencing decision-makers throughout the deal cycle.Strong experience in stakeholder management, project, product, and program management, and delivery leadership in consulting environments.Proven success in leading and delivering complex initiatives across industries in technology platforms.Strong knowledge of delivery frameworks (e.g., Agile, SAFe, Lean, PMBOK) and ability to apply them pragmatically.Experience leading large, cross-functional teams with accountability for delivery quality, client satisfaction, and financial outcomes (revenue, utilization, margin, profitability).Track record of supporting pursuits and contributing to the sales lifecycle, including solutioning, scoping, and estimation.Skilled in anticipating risks, managing dependencies, adapting plans, and driving alignment with stakeholders.Hands-on experience with modern delivery practices, including agile ceremonies, backlog management, and scaled frameworks.Experience managing engagements under different contractual structures.Strong business acumen, executive communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
About UsSlalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 
Compensation and BenefitsSlalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.
Slalom is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For this role, we are hiring at the following levels and targeted base pay salary ranges: The targeted base salary pay range for Senior Principal is $165,000 to $190,000. In addition, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. Actual compensation will depend upon an individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.    
We are committed to pay transparency and compliance with applicable laws. If you have questions or concerns about the pay range or other compensation information in this posting, please contact us at: peopleone@slalom.com. Please note this recipient is not able to support recruitment inquiries beyond this purpose.
EEO and AccommodationsSlalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

rows.title: Capgemini Invent, Consultant, AI Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

About The Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

At Capgemini Invent, the Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team helps organizations unlock the full value of their data and AI investments to drive meaningful, scalable change. As part of Capgemini's Strategy & Transformation Consulting practice, DDT partners with clients to shape data-centric strategies, modern operating models, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Our unified team model brings together expertise across Data & AI Advisory, Data Platforms & Architecture, and Applied Data Fusion, enabling seamless collaboration from strategy through execution.

Your Role

You will build and deploy defined AI components within a broader architecture.

Key Responsibilities Include

Build AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows.Implement RAG, tool-calling, and basic agents.Write clean Python and SQL.Support proofs of concept and benchmarks.Document designs and join client technical sessions.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience

3–5 years in software, data, or AI engineering.Python, SQL, API, and cloud experience.Exposure to LLM, prompting, RAG, and agents.Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure.Strong engineering fundamentals.

The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $110,000-$137,500

Capgemini provides compensation range information in accordance with applicable national, state, provincial, and local pay transparency laws. The base compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Capgemini, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. This range may be subject to change as permitted by law.

The actual compensation offered to any candidate may fall outside of the posted range and will be determined based on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

These may include, but are not limited to: Geographic location, Education and qualifications, Certifications and licenses, Relevant experience and skills, Seniority and performance, Market and business consideration, Internal pay equity.

It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws.

Benefits

Capgemini offers a comprehensive, non-negotiable benefits package to all regular, full-time employees. In the U.S. and Canada, available benefits are determined by local policy and eligibility and may include:

Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick LeaveMedical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada)Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada)Life and disability insuranceEmployee assistance programsOther benefits as provided by local policy and eligibility

Important Notice: Compensation (including bonuses, commissions, or other forms of incentive pay) is not considered earned, vested, or payable until it becomes due under the terms of applicable plans or agreements and is subject to Capgemini’s discretion, consistent with applicable laws. The Company reserves the right to amend or withdraw compensation programs at any time, within the limits of applicable legislation.

Disclaimers

Capgemini is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging inclusion in the workplace. Capgemini also participates in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) program which supports meaningful engagement with Indigenous communities across Canada by promoting fairness, accessibility, inclusion and respect. We value the rich cultural heritage and contributions of Indigenous Peoples and actively work to create a welcoming and respectful environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity/expression, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, genetics, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law.

This is a general description of the Duties, Responsibilities and Qualifications required for this position. Physical, mental, sensory or environmental demands may be referenced in an attempt to communicate the manner in which this position traditionally is performed. Whenever necessary to provide individuals with disabilities an equal employment opportunity, Capgemini will consider reasonable accommodations that might involve varying job requirements and/or changing the way this job is performed, provided that such accommodation does not pose an undue hardship. Capgemini is committed to providing reasonable accommodation during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodation, please reach out to your recruiting contact.

Please be aware that Capgemini may capture your image (video or screenshot) during the interview process and that image may be used for verification, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

Click the following link for more information on your rights as an Applicant in the United States. http://www.capgemini.com/resources/equal-employment-opportunity-is-the-law

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

rows.title: Technology Manager – CPG / Retail / Distribution
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

ZS Beyond Healthcare Team: ZS is guiding global clients across Travel, Hospitality, Retail, Financial Services, QSR, and Agri-Tech to help drive revenue growth, operational excellence, and personalized engagement using data, analytics, and technology. We help organizations move from traditional systems to intelligent, adaptive, and GenAI-enabled ecosystems that drive business outcomes.

Technology Manager – CPG / Retail / Distribution

What You’ll Do: As a Technology Manager on the Beyond Healthcare, you team will lead large-scale digital transformation programs for global clients, bridging business strategy and technology execution. You will partner closely with client stakeholders to design, deliver, and scale technology solutions that leverage modern cloud platforms, industry systems, and emerging AI capabilities. The role requires a unique blend of industry expertise, technical depth, and leadership acumen to drive measurable impact.

Lead business development and account expansion across Retail, CPG, Consumer Health, and Distribution clients — with a focus on cloud modernization, enterprise data platforms, advanced analytics, and GenAI-enabled commercial solutions;Build trusted, senior-level relationships (CIO/CTO/VP Data/VP Architecture) to shape digital transformation agendas, cloud roadmaps, and new program opportunities;Architect and guide the development of scalable solutions on GCP (preferred) — while contributing to reusable assets, accelerators, and ZS IP;Lead estimation, capacity planning, solution coordination and delivery across the technology stack (BI, Analytics, AI, Digital, Big Data, Cloud, MDM), serving as the client escalation point;Provide project leadership across one or more programs while maintaining a high-quality client experience;Drive high-quality onshore/offshore delivery execution across multiple engagements — ensuring proactive risk management, stakeholder alignment, and consistent delivery excellence;Bring outside-in perspective on cloud, data engineering, digital engineering, and GenAI trends to shape client POVs and thought leadership in the consumer ecosystem;Deeply understand client business challenges and proactively bring forward differentiated ZS thinking to solve them;Partner with Google alliance teams to strengthen ZS’s GCP presence and expand our footprint with Sysco and other strategic consumer clients;Mentor, coach and develop ZS architects, and consultants across US and India teams — building capability depth, talent development and culture.

What You’ll Bring:

Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, IT or related discipline; MBA a plus;10+ years of experience in technology consulting, solution delivery, or business development across Retail, CPG, Consumer Health, or Distribution industries.5+ years leading large, distributed delivery teams;Proven track record of driving revenue growth through technology-led transformation programs;Deep expertise in cloud ecosystems — GCP strongly preferred; AWS/Azure a plus;Strong experience with modern data engineering, analytics platforms, cloud-native architectures and enterprise-scale transformation programs;Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and convert business needs into technology value;Strong client presence and executive communication skills;Effective supervisory, coaching, and hands-on project leadership capabilities;Experience leading global, virtual teams to deliver multiple complex programs simultaneously;Entrepreneurial mindset — able to identify whitespace, shape offerings, and build assets aligned to Retail, CPG, Consumer Health, and Distribution client needs.

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

rows.title: Capgemini Invent, Consultant, AI Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

About The Job You're Considering

As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.

At Capgemini Invent, the Data Driven Transformation (DDT) team helps organizations unlock the full value of their data and AI investments to drive meaningful, scalable change. As part of Capgemini's Strategy & Transformation Consulting practice, DDT partners with clients to shape data-centric strategies, modern operating models, and AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Our unified team model brings together expertise across Data & AI Advisory, Data Platforms & Architecture, and Applied Data Fusion, enabling seamless collaboration from strategy through execution.

Your Role

You will build and deploy defined AI components within a broader architecture.

Key Responsibilities Include

Build AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows.Implement RAG, tool-calling, and basic agents.Write clean Python and SQL.Support proofs of concept and benchmarks.Document designs and join client technical sessions.

Your Skills + Experience

You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.

Required Experience

3–5 years in software, data, or AI engineering.Python, SQL, API, and cloud experience.Exposure to LLM, prompting, RAG, and agents.Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or Azure.Strong engineering fundamentals.

The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $110,000-$137,500

It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range.

In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws.

Benefits

Capgemini offers a comprehensive, non-negotiable benefits package to all regular, full-time employees. In the U.S. and Canada, available benefits are determined by local policy and eligibility and may include:

Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick LeaveMedical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada)Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada)Life and disability insuranceEmployee assistance programsOther benefits as provided by local policy and eligibility

Important Notice: Compensation (including bonuses, commissions, or other forms of incentive pay) is not considered earned, vested, or payable until it becomes due under the terms of applicable plans or agreements and is subject to Capgemini’s discretion, consistent with applicable laws. The Company reserves the right to amend or withdraw compensation programs at any time, within the limits of applicable legislation.

Disclaimers

Capgemini is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging inclusion in the workplace. Capgemini also participates in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) program which supports meaningful engagement with Indigenous communities across Canada by promoting fairness, accessibility, inclusion and respect. We value the rich cultural heritage and contributions of Indigenous Peoples and actively work to create a welcoming and respectful environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity/expression, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, genetics, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Physical, mental, sensory or environmental demands may be referenced in an attempt to communicate the manner in which this position traditionally is performed. Whenever necessary to provide individuals with disabilities an equal employment opportunity, Capgemini will consider reasonable accommodations that might involve varying job requirements and/or changing the way this job is performed, provided that such accommodation does not pose an undue hardship. Capgemini is committed to providing reasonable accommodation during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodation, please reach out to your recruiting contact.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

rows.title: Manager, Data Engineering
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

As a Manager, Data Engineering, you will play a central role in designing and building the data foundation that powers enterprise analytics, operational reporting, and future AI-driven capabilities. Working across Trading, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams, you ll help deliver scalable solutions that connect complex business systems, improve data accessibility, and drive better business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to work on large-scale data engineering challenges, modern cloud technologies, and high-value business initiatives while helping shape the future of the organization s data platform.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Integration, Data Platform Development, or related technical roles.Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data engineering solutions and cloud-based data platforms.Strong experience building scalable data pipelines and data integration frameworks.Experience working with large-scale enterprise data environments and complex business systems.Strong understanding of data modeling, data architecture, and modern data engineering practices.Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in Energy, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Commodity Trading, Financial Services, or other highly data-intensive industries.Hands-on experience with:DatabricksAzure Data FactoryAzure Synapse AnalyticsSnowflakeApache SparkDelta LakeExperience supporting Data Product, Data Mesh, or modern data platform initiatives.Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated deployment frameworks.Experience integrating large-scale trading, market, operational, and financial systems.Experience working within Agile delivery organizations and cross-functional engineering teams.
Additional Information

Level: Manager

Compensation Range: Depending on Experience - $140,000 - $180,000

Benefits Of Working Here

An inclusive workplace that promotes diversity and collaboration.Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities.Competitive compensation and benefits package.Flexibility to support work-life balance.Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family.Generous paid leave and holidays.Wellness program and employee assistance.

The range shown represents a grouping of relevant ranges currently in use at Publicis Sapient. Actual range for this position may differ, depending on location and specific skillset required for the work itself.

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

Company Description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Senior Engineer, ADL Platform Administrator to join our Digital Nexus technology organization.

Responsibilities:

Provide comprehensive administration and operational support for the Azure Data Lake platform, specifically managing Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and Azure Data Factory (ADF)Oversee user provisioning, group administration, tokens, secrets, and Key Vault security and access controlsManage the health, performance, and permission structures of Databricks clusters and SQL endpoints to ensure optimal system efficiencyConfigure and maintain storage solutions, linked services, and application integrations while adhering to strict security standardsLeverage strong Python, SQL and PowerShell scripting capabilities to automate administrative tasks, monitor platform health, and streamline operationsDrive and support the deployment of code, patches, and upgrades to the production environment while ensuring strict change control complianceAct with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum three years of recent experience of platform administration experience focusing on Azure Databricks which includes Unity catalog, Lakebase Postgres, Databricks Apps and Genie Agent; Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and Azure Data Factory (ADF)Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred; minimum of a high school diploma or GED is required; or five years of equivalent working experience Extensive experience configuring Databricks networking, Unity Catalog, security policies (NCC, egress, compute controls), and integrating enterprise tools like Salesforce, Informatica, Oracle, and SAP HANAStrong understanding of Azure Key Vault, storage accounts (ACLs, roles), service principals, system/user-assigned managed identities, and secure access control practicesHighly proficient in Python, PowerShell, PySpark, SQL, and KQL for platform automation, system log analysis (Log Analytics), privilege management, and ADF linked service configurationProven ability to manage CI/CD concepts (Azure DevOps, managed code deployments) and troubleshoot complex pipeline integrations across ADF, Databricks, and SQL databasesApplicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

rows.title: Lead, Trust & Safety U.S. Operations

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles. Every day around the globe, millions of people use Snapchat to communicate with friends, build relationships, play, and learn. No matter where you are or how you express yourself, it’s always the fastest way to share a moment!

The Trust & Safety (T&S) Team plays an important role in protecting our Snapchatters from content that violates our terms of service or Community Guidelines — while constantly embodying our values of Kind, Smart, and Creative. The T&S team helps create a safe platform experience so that all of our users around the world are empowered to enjoy their experience on our platform, every day. We take great pride in our work as digital first responders and hope you would consider joining us.

We’re looking for a Lead to join our Trust & Safety Global Operations & Enablement team which works cross-functionally with our Policy, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to keep Snapchatters safe on our platform. While this role will serve as a key Lead within our Trust & Safety Global Operations team, as Snap’s regulatory footprint has expanded, this role includes supporting the implementation of legal and regulatory compliance matters, as well as policy. . This role requires a skilled and unflappable decision maker who has a passion for ideating and developing safety workflows in order to improve the experience for Snapchatters everywhere.

You’ll become a subject matter authority in multiple domains by owning projects from beginning to finish and facilitating cross-team communication with our Global Safety Partners to help keep Snapchatters safe.

This is a people manager role, with a team that will be based in NY, though you should expect to lead and coordinate across timezones (e.g. London, NYC, LA) as part of a global, matrixed operating model.

Due to the nature of Trust & Safety work, you should be willing and able to work with sensitive issues and content that may be considered offensive or disturbing. Our team has carefully devised measures and support in place to ensure wellness for all our team members.

What you’ll do:

Provide leadership and guidance for a growing team of T&S Specialists by becoming a subject matter expert in our workflowsEnhance our operational workflows by identifying focus areas and implementing improvementsLiaise with our global safety partners and further strengthen those relationships Use data to influence decisions and highlight emerging issues impacting usersAnticipate risks, manage escalations and balance business needs versus technical constraintsHandle time-sensitive inquiries from users or other key stakeholders, both internal and external, and drive an end to end resolutionDeliver key projects within the Safety roadmap, incorporating execution, training, data assessment and presentation of results to stakeholdersRegularly identify opportunities to enhance internal processes and improve efficiency, while driving longer-term scalable automated solutionsClosely follow industry trends to help develop Snap’s thought leadership and T&S operationBe willing and able to work with sensitive issues and content that includes but is not limited to child exploitation, graphic violence, self-harm,and others, which may be considered offensive or disturbing 

Knowledge, skills, & abilities:

Proven leadership capacity with the ability to attract, motivate, develop and retain talentExperience reviewing sensitive content with a meticulous attention to detailA track record of identifying gaps and solutions, and implementing new processes – from a policy, operations, and/or tooling perspectiveStrong analytical skills, including working with large data sets to solve business problems, and providing practical business insights via data visualization software (Advanced EXCEL, Looker, Tableau, etc.)Prior experience interacting with regulatory bodies, NCMEC or law enforcementGreat judgment in complex situations and ability to problem-solve, both independently and with peers or managementExcellent verbal and written communication skillsExperience working with product and engineering teams to launch tools and solutions that improve trust across a platform or productContribute to the development of Trust & Safety’s scalable enforcement guidance by collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Product, Operations, Trust, Legal, and Communications. Analyze enforcement, product, market, and other relevant data to refine policy and enforcement guidance, while proactively identifying risk areas and emerging integrity challenges. Demonstrate the ability to deeply analyze complex issues and identify actionable decisions that can be scaled across manual and automated moderation systems. Strong investigative skills coupled with a curiosity that leads to identifying and understanding root causesProven ability for strategic and critical thinking, demonstrating strong attention to detail while maintaining an understanding of the big picture and the value of both perspectives. A proven track record of effective leadership with the ability to independently manage a portfolio of complex issues, end to endComfort with ambiguity and rapidly shifting scope — this role's boundaries move as the team's and Snap’s needs growWorking experience with the product development lifecycle within technology, regulations, and/or industry landscape. A passion for Snapchat, online safety, and creativity!

Minimum Qualifications:

4+ years of relevant experience Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

rows.title: Product Risk Program Manager
rows.descriptionText:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Proven expertise in both Performance and Brand advertising, with a strong track record of delivering impactful social marketing solutions. Analytical mindset, with the ability to leverage data and insights to inform creative decisions. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 

Minimum Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in creative strategy, brand marketing, or a related field. 3+ years of experience managing and developing teams. Demonstrated success in delivering both DR and Brand campaigns. Hands-on experience working with large clients across a range of categories.

Meta is seeking talented experienced engineers to join our teams in building cutting-edge products that connect billions of people around the world. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work on complex technical problems, build new features, and improve existing products across various platforms, including mobile devices and web applications. Our teams are constantly pushing the boundaries of user experience, and we're looking for passionate individuals who can help us advance the way people connect globally. If you're interested in joining a world-class team of engineers and researchers to work on exciting projects that have significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build innovative application experiencesImplement custom user interfaces using latest programming techniques and technologiesAnalyze and optimize code for quality, efficiency, and performance, and provide feedback to peers during code reviewsSet direction and goals for teams, lead major initiatives, provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers, and help onboard new team membersArchitect efficient and scalable systems that drive complex applicationsIdentify and resolve performance and scalability issues, and drive large efforts to reduce technical debtWork on a variety of coding languages and technologiesEstablish ownership of components, features, or systems with expert end-to-end understanding

rows.title: Capacity Planning Optimization Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Meta is seeking a Capacity Planning Optimization Lead to join the Capacity Engineering team, where you will play a critical role in ensuring Meta's infrastructure scales reliably and efficiently to meet the demands of billions of users across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and emerging AI and metaverse workloads. In this role, you will develop and drive capacity modeling, performance benchmarking, and demand forecasting strategies that inform infrastructure investment decisions at scale. You will partner with product, infrastructure, and finance teams to translate workload growth signals into actionable capacity plans, ensuring Meta's server, network, and data center resources are optimally provisioned across all planning horizons.

Capacity Planning Optimization Lead Responsibilities:

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience8+ years of experience working in Infrastructure/Cloud/Hardware with a background in Strategy, Capacity Planning, Supply Chain Optimization, or technology strategy consultingExperience leading enterprise-level Planning processes with frequent executive interactionExperience distilling complex data and high ambiguity into actionable insights and recommendations, to quickly separate signal from noise for executive communication and decision-makingBusiness acumen with experience forming and refining hypotheses into actionable analysis and recommendationsExperience identifying and framing complex or ambiguous infrastructure problems, defining opportunity spaces, and developing actionable strategiesExperience in completing multiple cloud, infrastructure, or hardware optimization projects

rows.title: Research Scientist, Demography and Survey Sciences

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
The Demography and Survey Science team's mission is to improve the way we make decisions and measure impact both within and outside of Meta. We collect and analyze rich survey and behavioral datasets to understand new challenges, solve problems, and shape decisions. We are looking for quantitative social scientists with experience answering complex research questions to join us in this effort.Our interdisciplinary team includes those with expertise in statistical inference, survey methodology, causal inference and econometrics, regression modeling, exploratory data analysis, and mathematical demography, among other areas. In this role, you’ll own research end-to-end. This means you’ll navigate trade-offs while designing projects, proposing appropriate methodologies, analyzing data, and communicating results to broad audiences in order to drive impactful decisions.Strong candidates may include social scientists, applied statisticians, or other applied researchers with expertise in quantitative research methods, experience working with large datasets and relational databases, and experience with survey methodology (e.g., bias correction, sampling). We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate methodological rigor, experience communicating research findings in writing and in presentations to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and the ability to make research design choices that balance competing tradeoffs effectively.

Research Scientist, Demography and Survey Sciences Responsibilities:

Develop a research agenda and drive research projects from end-to-endCollaborate with cross-functional teams across the company to define relevant research questionsDesign and deploy appropriate research methodologies to answer those questionsDevelop innovative new approaches to resolve challenging problemsProvide teams with usable measurement strategies and methodologies to make better decisionsDeliver insights and recommendations clearly to relevant audiences

2+ years of experience in quantitative research, data analysis, or a related fieldBachelor's, Master's or Ph.D. in the social sciences (e.g., Economics, Political Science, Sociology, Psychology, Communication), or in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Informatics, Econometrics)Demonstrated experience in designing original research to address complex questionsDemonstrated expertise in data manipulation and analysis software and programming languages (Python/R, SQL)Expertise and applied experience in measurement (e.g., survey design and analysis, experiment design, bias correction, measurement models, data collection, log data) and statistical inference (e.g., causal, Bayesian, machine learning)Experience initiating and driving research projects to completion with minimal guidanceExperience communicating analyses and results to broad audiencesDemonstrated ability to distill and communicate research insights to influence others' thinking, decision-making, and actions

rows.descriptionText:
We're building AI agents that make every cross-functional discipline at Meta — Finance, Legal, People, Policy, Comms, Partnerships, Sales — 10x more effective. The ATA XFN team operates as a portfolio of startups inside Meta. Each pod embeds directly into an XFN organization, discovers high-value workflows, builds AI agents that collapse them, and creates feedback loops that continuously improve our models. We focus on effectiveness, not just efficiency — building tools that change what XFN professionals can do, not just how fast they do it.The XFN Pod Group PM owns product strategy for a large product area within one one of 7 XFN disciplines. You work directly with XFN domain experts (lawyers, finance analysts, recruiters, policy specialists) to discover their highest-value workflows, define what agents should do, set quality rubrics, drive adoption, and measure impact. You prototype alongside engineers. You ship weekly demos. You own the customer relationship for your product area end-to-end.

You will personally prototype, build, evaluate, and ship AI systems, working directly in the code and with production data. As a Security Engineer in AAI, you will apply deep domain expertise to solve hard, real-world security problems, building novel security capabilities, prototyping AI-powered defenses, and advancing the frontier of what AI systems can do in security. Your work is AI-augmented from day one: you leverage AI tools and agents to accelerate your impact, and where the models fall short, your expertise directly drives their improvement.You will blend hands-on security engineering with applied research: designing and executing novel approaches to security challenges that push both the state of Meta's security posture and the state of the art in AI-driven security. This includes building security products and tools, conducting original adversary research, developing detection and response capabilities, and translating security expertise into scalable, AI-native systems. Your domain knowledge — whether in detection engineering, threat intelligence and adversary analysis, cloud security, adversary simulation, mobile and platform security, forensic investigation, or emerging areas like AI/ML security — becomes the foundation for capabilities no existing AI system can replicate.This role is for security practitioners who want to operate at the intersection of deep security expertise and frontier AI — not just using AI as a tool, but shaping what it becomes.

Security Engineer, Applied AI Responsibilities:

Apply deep security domain expertise to identify, scope, and solve complex security problems that require multi-step reasoning, novel approaches, and expert judgmentBuild security products, tools, and capabilities — prototyping AI-driven solutions to real-world security challenges at Meta's scaleDesign and execute adversarial research, threat intelligence analysis, detection engineering, platform security research, or investigation workflows augmented by AI tools and agentsIdentify where AI models lack security reasoning capability and directly contribute to improving them through expert-generated signals, evaluation, and feedbackDevelop novel methodologies and reusable approaches that advance both Meta's security posture and AI system performance in security domainsCollaborate with model researchers to translate security expertise into training signal — decomposing hard problems into structured challenges that teach models to reason like security expertsPartner cross-functionally with engineering, product, and research teams to incorporate security innovations into production AI systemsDrive end-to-end execution of complex security initiatives with independence, contributing to the technical direction within the teamDisseminate findings through internal publications, knowledge sharing, and contributions to the broader security community

Minimum Qualifications:

B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent experience5+ years of hands-on security engineering experience in one or more domains: detection engineering, threat intelligence, incident response, cloud security, adversarial simulation, offensive security, mobile/platform security, or digital forensicsExtensive knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and proceduresProficiency in coding with experience in languages such as Python, Go, C/C++, or shell scriptingExperience building security systems, tools, or capabilities — not just identifying problems but engineering solutionsDemonstrated ability to operate independently on complex, ambiguous security challenges

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with forensic investigation — reconstructing attack timelines from evidence across multiple sourcesDemonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologiesContributions to the security community (original research, tools, CTF design, conference presentations, publications, vulnerability disclosures)Background in supply chain security, mobile platform security, network protocol security, or AI/agent securityExperience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)Experience improving AI model performance through expert feedback, red-teaming, or evaluation designExperience in planning and executing adversary simulation campaigns or purple team exercises at scaleExperience with mobile platform security (iOS/Android), including IPC exploitation, secure enclave analysis, or platform-specific vulnerability researchExperience with cloud security operations (AWS/GCP/Azure), cloud detection and response, or cloud-native defenseExperience in creating structured methodologies that scale security expertise across teams

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. rows.title: Product Risk Program Manager
rows.descriptionText:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.

rows.title: Customer Relationship Management Analyst - FTC
rows.descriptionText:
Born on South Molton Street, London in 1971, Molton Brown is an icon of uniquely British style. Today, Molton Brown is one of the leading global brands in Kao´s global cosmetics portfolio. Growing from small-scale artisans into the international fragrance brand it is today, its pioneering presence is felt in our stores and websites, travel retail, luxury department stores and the most esteemed hotels around the world.

Expertly blended in London, Molton Brown’s signature fragrances, bath and shower gels, home and hand care luxuries have claimed iconic status. Kao and Molton Brown have a passion for integrity, for craftsmanship, for artistry and for giving our consumers the ultimate, quality experience.

About our role:

12-14 months Fixed Term Contract

To support the digital business and the CRM Manager by providing customer behaviour and lifetime value insight, reporting globally across all channels and markets and manage the Digital Optimisation and Analytics Executive . To provide customer and sales analysis and conclusions to the business on a regular basis to ensure the right planning is in place to grow and retain the Molton Brown customer base.

The role is central to the customer lifetime value initiative, the development of the loyalty program and the foundation of understanding the recency, frequency, and value metrics of our customers and insight into product performance across different consumer and business segments.

What you will do:

Support the CRM Manager in maintaining customer insight and customer lifetime value reporting to all levels of the business. Insight includes key customer metric's such as Lifetime Value, Churn, Recency Frequency and Monetary value, Tiering and customer journeys. Create customer tiering target models, based on Recency, Frequency and Monetary value data to facilitate customer segmentation and communication planning. Regularly report on CLV (customer lifetime value) metrics, maintaining and distributing the CRM dashboard. Identifying consumer behaviour trends, recommending improvements to activities to ensure maximum ROI on spend. Conduct campaign wash-up analysis of customer activity, and evaluate successes and opportunities for future campaign planning based on customer reactions. Review and analyse customer feedback from customer surveys, social media, online reviews and any other relevant sources. Monitor and report on competitor and customer loyalty trends (including to international territories). Support the CRM Manager in planning and executing customer research activities to support the business. Manage and provide support to the Digital analytics and optimization Executive

What you will need:

Graduate or equivalent with an analytical background3+ years experience operating in a CRM Analyst level roleCommercial awarenessExperience working with RFM modellingExperience reporting loyalty data and Customer insight for email segmentationAdvanced Excel - Ability to manipulate data using v-lookups, pivot tables and advanced formulasExperience using Business Insights tool preferableSQL, Fabric or equivalent usefulWork experience and interest in retail and health & beauty preferable

Molton Brown is part of Kao founded in Japan in 1887, at Kao, we believe the diversity of our teams strengthens our global mission. Here we trust and respect each other, collaborating in a friendly and inclusive work environment to achieve great results.

What you can expect from us:

An entrepreneurial environment where passionate and innovative teams come together. Respect, teamwork and collaboration are at the heart of how we work. A workplace culture that prioritises employee wellbeing, with opportunities to get involved in initiatives such as Mental Health First Aiders, the Charity Committee, and DE&I communities (region dependant)A broad range of benefits, including flexible working, competitive salaries, health and wellbeing offers, pension / retirement options dependant on location, insurance options, and more… Learning and development opportunities 

Your voice matters here — we value entrepreneurial thinking and innovation from our teams. To find out why 33,000 people across the Globe work at Kao please visit: https://www.kao.com/emea/en/careers/

Discover careers at Kao and how we live our purpose, Kirei – Making Life Beautiful. https://kao.voyse.io/

Our Privacy Policy: https://www.kao.com/emea/en/privacy/

NATIONAL ACCOUNT MANAGER – CONSUMER BEAUTY DIVISIONSALES & COMMERCIALSW19 – Wimbledon (2 to 3 days per week in the office)
Shape the future of Beauty across some of the world's most loved and recognisable consumer brands.

As part of Coty's Consumer Beauty Division, you will play a key role in driving the growth and strategic direction of our business across leading UK retail partners. This role combines commercial ownership, customer leadership, strategic thinking, innovation and operational excellence to deliver sustainable growth across a portfolio of category-leading beauty brands.
More than a traditional account management role, this is an opportunity to operate at the centre of a fast-moving, highly visible business, influencing commercial decisions, building strategic retailer partnerships and helping shape the future of how Beauty is discovered, shopped and experienced.

Combining strategic thinking with commercial acumen and strong stakeholder management skills, you will transform customer opportunities into commercially impactful plans that drive growth, strengthen partnerships and elevate brand performance.

Accelerate Innovation, Digital & AI-Enabled GrowthLeverage AI-powered tools and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, planning and commercial decision making.Explore emerging technologies and innovative ways of working that unlock competitive advantage.Drive smarter, faster and more insight-led customer planning through data and automation.Partner with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for digital transformation and continuous improvement.Help shape future commercial capabilities by embracing experimentation, innovation and technology-led growth.Champion modern commercial practices that future-proof the business and enhance customer experiences.


YOU ARE A COTY FITYou are passionate about Beauty, Commercial Excellence and building strategic partnerships that drive business growth. You combine strong commercial acumen with analytical thinking and relationship-building skills, enabling you to influence decisions, unlock opportunities and deliver outstanding results.
You thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy taking ownership and have the confidence to challenge the status quo with innovative ideas.
Most importantly, you are ambitious, entrepreneurial and excited by the opportunity to become a future commercial leader.
Other than that, you bring:Experience in National Account Management, Customer Development or Commercial roles.Experience within beauty, FMCG, personal care, retail or consumer goods environments.Proven experience managing customer relationships and delivering commercial growth.Strong forecasting, planning and analytical capabilities.Experience managing budgets, promotional investment and customer profitability.Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills.Strong commercial judgment with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.Experience collaborating effectively across multiple business functions.Advanced Microsoft Office skills including PowerPoint and Excel.Experience working with data-driven decision making and commercial reporting.Curiosity around technology, AI and emerging commercial capabilities.Excellent attention to detail combined with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

WHAT WE OFFERThis is a unique role with a genuine opportunity to make an impact. You'll get to work across some of the most recognised and culturally relevant beauty brands in the world while collaborating with a diverse team of professionals who are passionate about driving commercial excellence and shaping the future of beauty.
And if you'd like to build a successful career in the beauty industry...
At Coty, we have a strong track record of accelerating careers and creating opportunities well beyond your first role.
A career at Coty could take you in many directions, including:
Commercial Leadership Career ProgressionProgress from National Account Manager to Senior National Account Manager, Customer Business Manager, National Business Manager and broader Commercial Leadership roles.Take ownership of increasingly strategic customer portfolios, larger P&Ls and more complex commercial responsibilities.Lead transformational growth initiatives across some of the world's most recognised consumer beauty brands.Develop into a future Commercial Director or General Manager through exposure to senior stakeholders, strategic customers and large-scale business challenges.

Wherever you want your career to go, Coty offers the scale, brands, people and opportunities to help you get there.

rows.title: Global Social Media Content & Community Assistant
rows.descriptionText:
GLOBAL SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT & COMMUNITY ASSISTANT

RIMMEL, MAX FACTOR, BOURJOIS

LONDON

Immediate starting

13 months

We’re Coty, a global leader in beauty. We’re World #1 in Fragrance,

and World #3 in Colour Cosmetics. Our iconic portfolio of brands are sold in over 150 countries around the world. We believe in beauty with a purpose and brands that inspire, no matter where they are in the world.

BACKGROUND TO THE ROLE

The Global Social Media Content & Community Assistant supports the development and execution of social-first content, community engagement and cultural conversations across a portfolio of colour cosmetics brands.

Working closely with Global Brand Teams, Creative, Advocacy & Influencer Marketing, Digital Commerce and local markets, this role helps bring brand storytelling to life across social platforms. From content planning and asset management to community insights, social reporting and trend spotting, the role plays a key part in ensuring brands remain culturally relevant, socially engaging and connected to consumers.

This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious marketer looking to develop expertise in content creation, social media strategy, community management and modern brand building within the beauty industry.

Key Responsibilities

Social Content Development

Support the creation and execution of global social media content plans across key platforms including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest and emerging channels. Assist in building social content calendars aligned with product launches, campaigns and cultural moments. Coordinate social content assets across internal teams, creative partners, agencies and markets. Support briefing, review and approval processes for social-first content. Assist in adapting campaign assets for platform-specific social execution. Maintain content libraries and ensure all assets are organised and accessible globally. 

Community Management & Consumer Engagement

Support the monitoring of brand communities across social platforms. Track conversations, comments and consumer sentiment to identify opportunities and risks. Assist in community engagement planning and best-practice recommendations for markets. Monitor emerging topics and cultural conversations relevant to the brands. Help identify opportunities to increase brand participation in relevant consumer conversations. Support social listening activities to better understand audience needs and behaviours. Contribute to building stronger consumer communities and advocacy opportunities across the portfolio. 

Content Creator & Advocacy Coordination

Partner closely with the Influencer Marketing and PR Team to coordinate creator content usage and timing across brand social channels. Assist in managing asset requests and content approvals. Support tracking of content performance and engagement. Help identify social content trends and formats that can be amplified through brand channels. Assist with content organisation and rights management. 

Trend & Cultural Insights

Monitor emerging platform trends, content formats, social innovations and viral conversations. Track beauty, fashion, entertainment and lifestyle trends influencing consumers. Conduct competitive social audits and benchmarking. Share regular trend reports and inspiration with the wider marketing organisation. Help identify opportunities for real-time content and cultural participation. 

Campaign & Launch Support

Support the execution of major campaign launches across social platforms. Assist in coordinating global launch assets and market implementation materials. Coordinate social content requirements across cross-functional stakeholders. 

Analytics & Reporting

Monitor engagement, reach, video views, audience growth and content effectiveness. Support preparation of monthly and quarterly social performance reports. Track campaign performance against KPIs and benchmarks. Help identify opportunities to optimise content strategy and community engagement. 

Project & Operational Management

Maintain content calendars, project timelines and status trackers. Support budget administration, purchase orders and agency management processes. Support preparation of leadership presentations and social media updates. 

What You Will Bring

Required Competencies: 

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business or related discipline. Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and emerging social platforms. RIMMEL, MAX FACTOR, BOURJOIS

rows.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Supply Chain
rows.descriptionText:
Job description:

 London
Currys London Campus at Waterloo
Permanent
Full Time
Grade 4   At Currys we're united by one passion: to help everyone enjoy amazing technology. As one of the best-known retailers of tech, we're proud of the service our customers receive and it's all down to our team of caring and committed colleagues. Join us and you'll work in a great team where you can be yourself and bring your personality. Working as one team, we learn and grow together, celebrating the big and small moments that make every day amazing.

Currys is in the middle of one of the most ambitious AI and automation shifts in UK retail. We are rethinking how customers discover and buy technology, how stores operate, how supply chains move, and how colleagues do their best work. The AI & Monetisation function is where the boldest bets get placed.

Supply chain is central to that shift. Every product we sell has to be in the right place, reach the customer as promised and, when it comes back, be returned to the supplier, refurbished or scrapped. Behind that sits a complex landscape of warehouse, order management and transport systems that is being modernised, and an experienced team that knows how it fits together.

You'll lead our Supply Chain squad directly, owning the data and AI products across forward fulfilment and returns. This is a role for a builder. We're looking for someone who has seen what a modern, data-driven logistics operation looks like, can shape that into a vision that fits Currys, and can bring an experienced team and its stakeholders with them as they move to a product way of working.

You'll partner with your squad's engineers, our Platform Engineering team and colleagues with deep supply chain knowledge, alongside senior leaders across Logistics and Home Delivery, to identify opportunities, rapidly prototype and then take solutions into production.

You'll work with source system owners and the teams leading our supply chain transformation programmes, and engage with IT Operations, InfoSec and Enablement on shared infrastructure, AI capabilities and governance.

You'll also coach and develop the Technical Product Manager you manage, and influence stakeholders at every level, from warehouse and delivery teams to senior leadership. Key responsibilities: 
You’ll build products with a modern data and AI stack: Claude Code, Databricks, dbt, and Omni. Additionally, you’ll need to:    Shape the data and AI product vision for Currys' logistics operation, bringing an outside-in view of what good looks like and turning it into a roadmap that operational leaders support Own the Supply Chain roadmap, covering forward fulfilment (stock, warehousing, transport and last mile) and returns (collection, receipt and onward routing) Manage and coach a Technical Product Manager, setting expectations, reviewing their work, and staying accountable for the roadmap they run day to day Lead discovery on the harder, more ambiguous problems: the ones that cut across the operation, have no obvious single owner, or need alignment from multiple senior stakeholders before they can start Establish product ways of working with a team and stakeholder group used to working from requests: a single route for new demand, discovery before build, and a prioritised roadmap with clear expectations of what will be delivered and when Agree data contracts with source system owners, so that data quality and integration issues are resolved at source rather than worked around downstream Determine the future of the existing reports and applications: which are replaced by new data products and which are retired, rather than rebuilt like for like on the new platform Run agile ceremonies, quarterly OKR setting and roadmap readouts across your squads, giving stakeholders one coherent view aligned to the wider AI & Monetisation roadmap    Required Skills & Experience:    6 years of experience in technical product management, working with data and analytics products, and LLM / ML solutions, including some experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers or Analysts Significant experience in supply chain, logistics or fulfilment, ideally in e-commerce, third-party logistics or a retailer with mature data and AI capability, and a clear point of view on what a modern, data-driven logistics operation looks like Working knowledge of supply chain systems (warehouse, order and transport management, and planning) and the data they produce, including the challenges of integrating them Demonstrated comfort working directly with engineers: you do not need to write production code, but you need to hold your own in technical conversations Extensive experience using AI tools to automate and improve your own workflows and your team's, with a clear point of view on how AI can improve the products you build Experience with agile delivery in cross-functional squads, including backlog management, sprint ceremonies, and OKR frameworks, ideally including introducing product ways of working to a team or stakeholder group new to them Strong stakeholder management skills with operational leaders, including the ability to manage competing priorities, push back constructively, and reset expectations where needed Familiarity with modern data stack concepts: medallion architecture, dimensional modelling, data lakes, semantic layers, or equivalent. Experience replacing legacy reports and systems during a platform migration would be an advantage Degree in a technical or business field, or equivalent experience You're a product builder: building POCs and prototypes rather than relying on others Cultivate meaningful relationships with your stakeholders, lead with empathy and foster a culture of collaboration with your peers Take real satisfaction in helping other Product Managers get better at the job, not just doing it well yourself Build your understanding of an operation first-hand, and are credible with warehouse teams and senior leaders alike  Why join us: We know our people are the secret to our success. That's why we're always looking for ways to reward great work. You'll find a host of benefits designed to work for you, including:

  25 days of annual leave (plus bank holiday entitlement) and a competitive pension scheme Private Medical Insurance Life Assurance Fantastic colleague discounts on Tech with Currys and iD Mobile Hybrid working (with an expectation to meet in person 2-4 times per month)  
Join our team and we’ll be with you every step of the way, helping you develop the career you want with new opportunities, on-going training and skills for life.   Not only can you shape your own future, but you can help take charge of ours too. As the biggest recycler and repairer of tech in the UK, we’re in a position to make a real impact on people and the planet.    Every voice has a space at our table and we’re committed to making inclusion and diversity part of everything we do, including how we strengthen our workforce. We want to make sure you have a fair opportunity to show us your talents during our application process, so if you need any additional assistance with your application please email careers@currys.co.uk and we’ll do our best to help.
